    (by rw [dzLay_tp, h12]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, hP12]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, h3]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, hP3])
  rw [hbits] at hspec
  obtain ⟨hfin, hto⟩ := hspec
  have hguard : ∀ (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, ∀ r,
      ((embedEmitTM κ.sR κ.HR).runFrom (qyC (x := z) (κ.iR (κ.rE, true)) 1
        (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) []) u).state ≠ some (κ.fR r) ∧
      ((embedEmitTM κ.sR κ.HR).runFrom (qyC (x := z) (κ.iR (κ.rE, true)) 1
        (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) []) u).state ≠ some (κ.oR r)) →
      ∀ u < t, ∀ s, ((dzQM κ .runR).runFrom (qyC (x := z) (κ.iR (κ.rE, true)) 1
        (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) []) u).state = some s →
          dzQRed κ .runR s = none := by
    intro t hc u hu s hs
    have h1 : ¬∃ b, s = κ.fR (some (κ.rA, b)) := fun ⟨b, hb⟩ =>
      (hc u hu (some (κ.rA, b))).1 (hs.trans (by rw [hb]))
    have h2 : ¬∃ r, s = κ.fR r := fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => (hc u hu r).1 (hs.trans (by rw [hr]))
    have h3 : ¬∃ r, s = κ.oR r := fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => (hc u hu r).2 (hs.trans (by rw [hr]))
    simp only [dzQRed, if_neg h1, if_neg h2, if_neg h3]
  by_cases hTG : TR ≤ G
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, b, T', P', hrun, -, -, hcutH⟩ := hfin TR hTG hstopTR hnot
    rw [hTR, Option.map_some] at hrun
    have hred : dzQRed κ .runR (κ.fR (some (v, b))) =
        some (if TR ≤ G ∧ v = κ.rA then dzAcc κ else dzRej κ) := by
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl
      · rw [if_pos ⟨hTG, rfl⟩]
        simp only [dzQRed]
        rw [if_pos ⟨b, rfl⟩]
      · rw [if_neg (fun h => κ.hAJ h.2.symm)]
        simp only [dzQRed]
        rw [if_neg (fun ⟨b', hb'⟩ =>
            κ.hAJ (congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some_inj.mp (κ.fRi hb'))).symm),
          if_pos ⟨_, rfl⟩]
    exact ⟨t + 1, by omega, T', P', qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .runR
      (κ.iR (κ.rE, true)) _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] t hrun hred (hguard t hcutH) (dzQF κ)
      (fun s => dz_notF κ .runR s (by simp) (by simp))⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, r, T', P', hrun, hcutH⟩ := hto (fun u hu h => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u TR with h' | h'
      · exact hnot u h' h
      · omega)
    have hred : dzQRed κ .runR (κ.oR r) =
        some (if TR ≤ G ∧ v = κ.rA then dzAcc κ else dzRej κ) := by
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hTG h.1)]
      simp only [dzQRed]
      rw [if_neg (fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => κ.fRo _ _ hb.symm), if_neg (fun ⟨r', hr'⟩ => κ.fRo _ _ hr'.symm),
        if_pos ⟨r, rfl⟩]
    exact ⟨t + 1, by omega, T', P', qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .runR
      (κ.iR (κ.rE, true)) _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] t hrun hred (hguard t hcutH) (dzQF κ)
      (fun s => dz_notF κ .runR s (by simp) (by simp))⟩

/-- **The top's hosted run and its read.** From the hosted decider's entry over a layout with the
query's tail on tape `8`, the capture tape and the decider's tapes blank, the clock's counter
`bits G` on tape `3`, these heads at `0`, the run reaches a verdict within `6G + 2|bits G| + 10`
steps; whenever the decider has halted on the tail by some `τ ≤ G`, the verdict is the acceptance
exactly when the decider's output at `τ` starts with `false`.

**Proof sketch.** The hosted clock's clause `κ.cB` at `BF`'s initial configuration on the tail
(read through `MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq` and `Cfg.init`'s equations), stopping at the halt. If the
decider halts by `G`, at its first halt `τ₀` (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt`) the finish
clause leaves its output on the capture tape (at most `τ₀` symbols,
`MultiTapeTM.output_length_le`); the dispatch rewinds it
(`qy_rewind`) and the take (`dz_take_run`) reads its first cell: `false` accepts, anything else
rejects. A halted run is fixed (`MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt`), so the output at every later
`τ ≤ G` is the same. Otherwise the timeout clause gives some `oB r`, rejected. -/
private theorem dz_top_run {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {z : List Bool} (L : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool) (Pn : Fin 14 → ℤ)
    (tail : List Bool) (G : ℕ) (h3 : L 3 = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits G))
    (h8 : L 8 = FinTM.bufferTape tail) (h12 : L 12 = FinTM.bufferTape [])
    (h13 : L 13 = FinTM.bufferTape []) (hP3 : Pn 3 = 0) (hP8 : Pn 8 = 0) (hP12 : Pn 12 = 0)
    (hP13 : Pn 13 = 0) :
    ∃ t ≤ 6 * G + 2 * (Nat.bits G).length + 10, ∃ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i)
      (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) ∧
      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.runB, κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)⟩ 1 (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape []))
          (dzLay Pn 0) [])
        (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t ∧
      ∀ τ ≤ G, (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg tail) τ).state = none →
        (v = dzAcc κ ↔ (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg tail) τ).output.head? = some false) := by
  set c0 := BF.tm.initCfg tail with hc0
  have hbits := qy_bits_val G
  have hspec := κ.cB (x := z) (κ.tp 8) (κ.tp 12) (κ.tp 3) κ.bB (κ.tp_ne (by decide))
    (κ.tp_ne (by decide)) (κ.tp_ne (by decide)) (fun ⟨i, h⟩ => κ.bB_ne i 8 (by decide) h)
    (fun ⟨i, h⟩ => κ.bB_ne i 12 (by decide) h) (fun ⟨i, h⟩ => κ.bB_ne i 3 (by decide) h)
    (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) [] c0 BF.tm.q₀ (Nat.bits G)
    (by rw [hc0, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state])
    (by rw [hc0, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos])
    (by rw [hc0, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_output]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, h8])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hP8])
    (fun i => by
      rw [hc0, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq]
      constructor
      · funext a
        rw [Cfg.init_workTapes]
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) = 0
        · have hk : 0 < BF.k := by have := i.isLt; omega
          rw [show i = ⟨0, hk⟩ from Fin.ext hi, show κ.bB ⟨0, hk⟩ = κ.tp 13 from rfl, dzLay_tp,
            h13, FinTM.bufferTape_nil]
        · have : 14 ≤ (κ.bB i : ℕ) := by
            unfold DzKit.bB
            exact dz_bank_off _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) i hi
          rw [dzLay_off _ _ _ this, FinTM.bufferTape_nil]
      · rw [Cfg.init_workTapePos]
        by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) = 0
        · have hk : 0 < BF.k := by have := i.isLt; omega
          rw [show i = ⟨0, hk⟩ from Fin.ext hi, show κ.bB ⟨0, hk⟩ = κ.tp 13 from rfl, dzLay_tp,
            hP13]
        · have : 14 ≤ (κ.bB i : ℕ) := by
            unfold DzKit.bB
            exact dz_bank_off _ _ _ _ _ (by omega) i hi
          rw [dzLay_off _ _ _ this])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, h12]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, hP12]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, h3]) (by rw [dzLay_tp, hP3])
  rw [hbits] at hspec
  obtain ⟨hfin, hto⟩ := hspec
  have hstopped : ∀ u, (BF.tm.runFrom c0 u).Stopped (fun _ => false) ↔
      (BF.tm.runFrom c0 u).state = none := by
    intro u
    rw [Cfg.stopped_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨s, -, hs⟩)
      · exact h
      · exact absurd hs (by simp)
    · exact Or.inl
  have hguard : ∀ (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, ∀ r,
      ((embedEmitTM κ.sB κ.HB).runFrom (qyC (x := z) (κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)) 1
        (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) []) u).state ≠ some (κ.fB r) ∧
      ((embedEmitTM κ.sB κ.HB).runFrom (qyC (x := z) (κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)) 1
        (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) []) u).state ≠ some (κ.oB r)) →
      ∀ u < t, ∀ s, ((dzQM κ .runB).runFrom (qyC (x := z) (κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)) 1
        (dzLay L (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Pn 0) []) u).state = some s →
          dzQRed κ .runB s = none := by
    intro t hc u hu s hs
    have h1 : ¬∃ r, s = κ.fB r := fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => (hc u hu r).1 (hs.trans (by rw [hr]))
    have h2 : ¬∃ r, s = κ.oB r := fun ⟨r, hr⟩ => (hc u hu r).2 (hs.trans (by rw [hr]))
    simp only [dzQRed, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
  by_cases hh : ∃ τ ≤ G, (BF.tm.runFrom c0 τ).state = none
  · obtain ⟨τw, hτw, hstw⟩ := hh
    obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀w, hlive0, heq0⟩ := MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt BF.tm c0 hstw
    have hτ₀G : τ₀ ≤ G := hτ₀w.trans hτw
    have hst0 : (BF.tm.runFrom c0 τ₀).state = none := by rw [heq0]; exact hstw
    obtain ⟨t, ht, b, T', P', hrun, hcap, hpos, hcutH⟩ := hfin τ₀ hτ₀G ((hstopped τ₀).mpr hst0)
      (fun u hu h => hlive0 u hu ((hstopped u).mp h))
    rw [hst0, Option.map_none] at hrun
    set out := (BF.tm.runFrom c0 τ₀).output with hout
    have seg1 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .runB (κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true))
      (κ.fB none) ⟨.rwK, RewindPhase.start⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] t hrun
      (by simp only [dzQRed]; rw [if_pos ⟨none, rfl⟩]) (hguard t hcutH) (dzQF κ)
      (fun s => dz_notF κ .runB s (by simp) (by simp))
    -- rwK: rewind the captured output
    have c2 := qy_rewind (x := z) (κ.tp 12) 1 T' P' [] out out.length le_rfl hcap hpos
    have seg2 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .rwK .start .done ⟨.rd, none⟩
      1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] _ c2.1 (by simp [dzQRed])
      (qy_guard_of_cut RewindPhase.done (dzQRed κ .rwK) (fun s hs => by simp [dzQRed, hs]) c2.2)
      (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .rwK s (by simp) (by simp))
    -- rd: read the captured output's first cell
    have c3 := dz_take_run (x := z) (κ.tp 12) 1 T' (Function.update P' (κ.tp 12) 0) []
    rw [Function.update_self, hcap] at c3
    set v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i := if out.head? = some false then dzAcc κ else dzRej κ with hv
    have hred : dzQRed κ .rd (some (FinTM.bufferTape out 0)) = some v := by
      rw [hv]
      rcases out with _ | ⟨b0, out'⟩
      · simp [dzQRed, FinTM.bufferTape_nil]
      · have e : FinTM.bufferTape (b0 :: out') 0 = some b0 := by
          simpa using FinTM.bufferTape_nat (b0 :: out') 0
        rw [e]
        cases b0 <;> simp [dzQRed]
    have seg3 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .rd none
      (some (FinTM.bufferTape out 0)) v 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] 1 c3 hred (fun u hu s hs => by
        obtain rfl : u = 0 := by omega
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at hs
        cases Option.some.inj hs
        simp [dzQRed]) (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .rd s (by simp) (by simp))
    refine ⟨_, ?_, v, _, _, ?_, seg1.trans (seg2.trans seg3), fun τ hτ hstτ => ?_⟩
    · have hlen : out.length ≤ τ₀ := by
        rw [hout, hc0]
        exact MultiTapeTM.output_length_le _ _ _
      omega
    · rw [hv]
      split_ifs
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl
    · have hle : τ₀ ≤ τ := Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hlt => hlive0 τ hlt hstτ
      have hsame := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_output_eq_of_halt BF.tm c0 hle hst0
      rw [hsame, ← hout, hv]
      split_ifs with hf
      · exact ⟨fun _ => hf, fun _ => rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (dz_acc_ne_rej κ).symm, fun h => absurd h hf⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, r, T', P', hrun, hcutH⟩ := hto (fun u hu h => hh ⟨u, hu, (hstopped u).mp h⟩)
    have hred : dzQRed κ .runB (κ.oB r) = some (dzRej κ) := by
      simp only [dzQRed]
      rw [if_neg (fun ⟨r', hr'⟩ => κ.fBo _ _ hr'.symm), if_pos ⟨r, rfl⟩]
    refine ⟨t + 1, by omega, dzRej κ, T', P', Or.inr rfl, qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩
      (dzQRed κ) .runB (κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)) _ _ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] t hrun hred (hguard t hcutH)
      (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .runB s (by simp) (by simp)), fun τ hτ hstτ => ?_⟩
    exact absurd ⟨τ, hτ, hstτ⟩ hh

/-! ### The run's three cases -/

/-- A word's binary value is below `2 ^ |w|`. -/
private theorem dz_word_lt (w : List Bool) : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) < 2 ^ w.length := by
  have h := Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length (b := 2) (l := w.map Bool.toNat) (by norm_num)
    (by
      intro d hd
      obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hd
      cases a <;> decide)
  rwa [List.length_map] at h

/-- A budget word as wide as `bits G` is worth at most `2G` (`qy_two_pow_bits_le`). -/
private theorem dz_budget_le (G : ℕ) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = (Nat.bits G).length) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ 2 * G := by
  have h1 := dz_word_lt w
  have h2 := qy_two_pow_bits_le G
  rw [hw] at h1
  omega

/-- The zero-padded bits of `t` are worth `t` (`Nat.ofDigits_append_replicate_zero`). -/
private theorem dz_padded_value (t r : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((Nat.bits t ++ List.replicate r false).map Bool.toNat) = t := by
  rw [List.map_append, List.map_replicate, Bool.toNat_false, Nat.ofDigits_append_replicate_zero,
    qy_bits_val]

/-- The run's time bound for `g n = G`. -/
private def dzQB {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (G : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) + 2 * κ.lcA + 140) * (G + 1)

/-- The run's entry layout's named tapes, as the setup leaves them with the block overwritten. -/
private theorem dz_entry_vals (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (z s : List Bool) :
    let L := Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6 (FinTM.bufferTape s)
    L 0 = FinTM.bufferTape (query f g z) ∧ L 2 = FinTM.bufferTape ([true] ++ z) ∧
      L 3 = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits (g z.length)) ∧ L 6 = FinTM.bufferTape s ∧
      L 7 = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate (g z.length) true) ∧ L 8 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
      L 9 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ L 10 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ L 11 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
      L 12 = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ L 13 = FinTM.bufferTape [] := by
  intro L
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [L, dzSetL]

/-- **The run off the stages.** When the query is empty, the run rejects at its flag. -/
private theorem dz_qoff {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z s : List Bool) (hq : query f g z = []) :
    ∃ t ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length), ∃ (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ),
      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [])
        (qyC (dzRej κ) 1 T' P' []) t := by
  obtain ⟨h0, -⟩ := dz_entry_vals f g z s
  rw [dzLay_const (0 : ℤ)]
  refine ⟨2, ?_, _, _, dz_flag κ _ (fun _ => 0) (query f g z) h0 rfl (dzRej κ) ?_⟩
  · unfold dzQB
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (g z.length + 1)
      (show 140 ≤ κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) + 2 * κ.lcA + 140 by omega)
    omega
  · rw [hq, FinTM.bufferTape_nil]
    rfl

/-- The buffer of `b :: tail` holds `b` at cell `0`: the query's flag, which the take reads. -/
private theorem dz_cell0 (b : Bool) (tail : List Bool) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (b :: tail) 0 = some b := by
  simpa using FinTM.bufferTape_nat (b :: tail) 0

/-- **The run at a top.** When the query is `true :: tail`, the run copies the tail and runs the
hosted decider on it (`dz_top_run`): it reaches a verdict within `dzQB κ (g n)` steps, the
acceptance exactly when the decider, halted by some `τ ≤ g n`, has an output starting with `false`.

**Proof sketch.** The flag (`dz_flag`, the first cell `true`), the tail's copy (`dz_tail_run`,
hosted), and `dz_top_run` over the entry layout's tapes (`dz_entry_vals`). The tail is shorter than
the query, whose length is at most `qcA (g n + 1)` (the kit's `qcL`). -/
private theorem dz_qtop {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z tail s : List Bool) (hq : query f g z = true :: tail) :
    ∃ t ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length), ∃ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool)
      (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) ∧
      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [])
        (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t ∧
      ∀ τ ≤ g z.length, (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg tail) τ).state = none →
        (v = dzAcc κ ↔ (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg tail) τ).output.head? = some false) := by
  obtain ⟨h0, -, h3, -, -, h8, -, -, -, h12, h13⟩ := dz_entry_vals f g z s
  rw [dzLay_const (0 : ℤ)]
  set L0 := Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6 (FinTM.bufferTape s) with hL0
  -- the flag
  have seg1 := dz_flag κ (z := z) L0 (fun _ => 0) (query f g z) h0 rfl ⟨.tt, SweepPhase.sweep⟩
    (by rw [hq, dz_cell0]; rfl)
  -- the tail's copy
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ : ∃ L1 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool,
      L1 = Function.update L0 0 (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape (query f g z)) 0 none) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z1, hZ1⟩ : ∃ Z1 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z1 = Function.update (fun _ => 0) 0 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL1, ← hZ1] at seg1
  have c2 := dz_tail_run (x := z) (κ.tp 0) (κ.tp 8) (κ.tp_ne (by decide)) 1
    (dzLay L1 (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Z1 0) [] true tail
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_self, hq])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1, Function.update_self])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h8])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide)])
  rw [dzLay_update] at c2
  have seg2 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .tt .sweep .done
    ⟨.runB, κ.iB (BF.tm.q₀, true)⟩ 1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] _ c2.1 (by simp [dzQRed])
    (qy_guard_of_cut SweepPhase.done (dzQRed κ .tt) (fun s hs => by simp [dzQRed, hs]) c2.2)
    (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .tt s (by simp) (by simp))
  -- the hosted decider and its read
  have hZ : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → Z1 i = 0 := fun i hi => by rw [hZ1, Function.update_of_ne hi]
  obtain ⟨t3, ht3, v, T', P', hv, seg3, hsem⟩ := dz_top_run κ (z := z)
    (Function.update L1 8 (FinTM.bufferTape tail)) Z1 tail (g z.length)
    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h3])
    (by rw [Function.update_self])
    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h12])
    (by rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h13])
    (hZ 3 (by decide)) (hZ 8 (by decide)) (hZ 12 (by decide)) (hZ 13 (by decide))
  refine ⟨_, ?_, v, T', P', hv, seg1.trans (seg2.trans seg3), hsem⟩
  have hqL := κ.qcL z
  rw [hq, List.length_cons] at hqL
  have hb := length_bits_le_self (g z.length)
  have hA : κ.qcA * (g z.length + 1) ≤ κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) * (g z.length + 1) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (7 * κ.acA + 8), ← mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  unfold dzQB
  nlinarith

/-- **The run in a middle.** When the query is `false :: tail`, `α = dzAlpha tail`, and the guessed
block is the stream `s₁` (of length `g n`), a separator and the budget word `w` (value `b`), the run
reaches a verdict within `dzQB κ (g n)` steps; it accepts only if `b ≤ g n` and the coded machine of
`α` accepts `1ⁿ` prefixed by `true` along `s₁.take b`, and it does accept when moreover the core's
constant `C` (its total-time clause for `α`, `hC`) has `C (b + 1) ≤ g n`.

**Proof sketch.** The flag (`dz_flag`), the tail's copy (`dz_tail_run`), the split (`dz_split`) and
the test (`dz_test`), which rejects when `g n < b`. Otherwise the normalization (`dz_norm`), the
rewrite (`dz_rewrite`, `α` by the extractor) and the hosted core (`dz_runR`) at the core's first
verdict time `T ≤ C (b + 1)` (`hC` with `t = b ≤ |s₁|`): the run accepts iff `T ≤ g n` and the
verdict is `accept`, i.e. the branch along `s₁.take b` halts with `[true]`. The times sum to at
most the bound: `b ≤ 2 g n` (`dz_budget_le`), `|bits b| ≤ b`, `|α| ≤ acA (|tail| + 1)` (the kit's
`acL`), `|tail| < |query| ≤ qcA (g n + 1)` and `n ≤ g n`. -/
private theorem dz_qmid {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z tail : List Bool) (hq : query f g z = false :: tail) (C : ℕ)
    (hC : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (s : List Bool), t ≤ s.length →
      ∃ T, T ≤ C * (t + 1) ∧
        (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) (dzAlpha tail)) x) κ.jR
            κ.rE s) T).state =
          some (if ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
                ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
              ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
                ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]
            then κ.rA else κ.rJ) ∧
        ∀ u < T,
          (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) (dzAlpha tail)) x)
              κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rA ∧
            (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) (dzAlpha tail)) x)
              κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rJ)
    (s₁ w : List Bool) (sp : Bool) (hs₁ : s₁.length = g z.length)
    (hw : w.length = (Nat.bits (g z.length)).length) :
    ∃ t ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length), ∃ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool)
      (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) ∧
      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True)
        (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
          (FinTM.bufferTape (s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w))) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [])
        (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t ∧
      (v = dzAcc κ → Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ g z.length ∧
        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).state = none ∧
        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).output = [true]) ∧
      (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) ≤ g z.length →
        C * (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) + 1) ≤ g z.length →
        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).state = none →
        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith
          (s₁.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat)))
          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).output = [true] →
        v = dzAcc κ) := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h2, h3, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, h12, -⟩ := dz_entry_vals f g z (s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w)
  rw [dzLay_const (0 : ℤ)]
  set G := g z.length with hG
  set b := Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) with hb
  set L0 := Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6 (FinTM.bufferTape (s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w)) with hL0
  -- the flag
  have seg1 := dz_flag κ (z := z) L0 (fun _ => 0) (query f g z) h0 rfl ⟨.mt, SweepPhase.sweep⟩
    (by rw [hq, dz_cell0]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ : ∃ L1 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool,
      L1 = Function.update L0 0 (Function.update (FinTM.bufferTape (query f g z)) 0 none) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z1, hZ1⟩ : ∃ Z1 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z1 = Function.update (fun _ => 0) 0 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL1, ← hZ1] at seg1
  have hZ1' : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → Z1 i = 0 := fun i hi => by rw [hZ1, Function.update_of_ne hi]
  -- the tail's copy
  have c2 := dz_tail_run (x := z) (κ.tp 0) (κ.tp 8) (κ.tp_ne (by decide)) 1
    (dzLay L1 (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (dzLay Z1 0) [] false tail
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_self, hq])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1, Function.update_self])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hL1, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h8])
    (by rw [dzLay_tp, hZ1' 8 (by decide)])
  rw [dzLay_update] at c2
  have seg2 := qy_hosted (dzQM κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzQRed κ) .mt .sweep .done ⟨.sb0, SeekPhase.run⟩
    1 1 _ _ _ _ [] [] _ c2.1 (by simp [dzQRed])
    (qy_guard_of_cut SweepPhase.done (dzQRed κ .mt) (fun s hs => by simp [dzQRed, hs]) c2.2)
    (dzQF κ) (fun s => dz_notF κ .mt s (by simp) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨L2, hL2⟩ : ∃ L2 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool,
      L2 = Function.update L1 8 (FinTM.bufferTape tail) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL2] at seg2
  -- the split
  obtain ⟨t3, ht3, seg3⟩ := dz_split κ (z := z) L2 Z1 s₁ w sp
    (by simp [hL2, hL1, h6]) (by simp [hL2, hL1, h7, hs₁]) (by simp [hL2, hL1, h9])
    (hZ1' 6 (by decide)) (hZ1' 7 (by decide)) (hZ1' 9 (by decide))
  obtain ⟨L3, hL3⟩ : ∃ L3 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool, L3 = Function.update
      (Function.update L2 6 (FinTM.bufferTape s₁)) 9 (FinTM.bufferTape w) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z3, hZ3⟩ : ∃ Z3 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z3 = Function.update Z1 7 ((s₁.length : ℤ) + 1) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL3, ← hZ3] at seg3
  have hZ3' : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 7 → Z3 i = 0 := fun i hi h7 => by
    rw [hZ3, Function.update_of_ne h7, hZ1' i hi]
  -- the test
  obtain ⟨t4, ht4, seg4⟩ := dz_test κ (z := z) L3 Z3 s₁ w (by simp [hL3])
    (by simp [hL3]) (by simp [hL3, hL2, hL1, h10]) (hZ3' 6 (by decide) (by decide))
    (hZ3' 9 (by decide) (by decide)) (hZ3' 10 (by decide) (by decide))
  rw [← hb] at seg4
  obtain ⟨L4, hL4⟩ : ∃ L4 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool, L4 = Function.update (Function.update L3 10
      (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate b true))) 9
      (FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate w.length true)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL4] at seg4
  -- the bounds common to both branches
  have hqL := κ.qcL z
  rw [hq, List.length_cons] at hqL
  have hbG := length_bits_le_self G
  have hb2 : b ≤ 2 * G := dz_budget_le G w hw
  have hA : κ.qcA * (G + 1) ≤ κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) * (G + 1) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (7 * κ.acA + 8), ← mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  by_cases hbG' : b ≤ G
  · rw [if_pos (by omega)] at seg4
    -- the normalization
    obtain ⟨t5, ht5, seg5⟩ := dz_norm κ (z := z) L4 Z3 b (by simp [hL4])
      (hZ3' 10 (by decide) (by decide))
    -- the rewrite
    obtain ⟨t6, ht6, seg6⟩ := dz_rewrite κ (z := z) (Function.update L4 10
      (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits b))) Z3 tail (Nat.bits b)
      (by simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h2]) (by simp [hL4, hL3, hL2])
      (by simp) (by simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h11]) (hZ3' 2 (by decide) (by decide))
      (hZ3' 8 (by decide) (by decide)) (hZ3' 10 (by decide) (by decide))
      (hZ3' 11 (by decide) (by decide))
    -- the hosted core
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hst, hcut⟩ := hC ([true] ++ z) b s₁ (by omega)
    obtain ⟨L6, hL6⟩ : ∃ L6 : Fin 14 → ℤ → Option Bool, L6 = Function.update (Function.update
        (Function.update L4 10 (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits b))) 8
        (FinTM.bufferTape (dzAlpha tail))) 11
        (FinTM.bufferTape (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits b) (dzAlpha tail)) ([true] ++ z))) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Z6, hZ6⟩ : ∃ Z6 : Fin 14 → ℤ, Z6 = Function.update (Function.update (Function.update
        Z3 10 ((Nat.bits b).length : ℤ)) 8 ((dzAlpha tail).length : ℤ)) 2
        ((([true] ++ z).length : ℕ) : ℤ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hL6, ← hZ6] at seg6
    have hZ6' : ∀ i : Fin 14, i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 7 → i ≠ 10 → i ≠ 8 → i ≠ 2 → Z6 i = 0 :=
      fun i h0 h7 h10 h8 h2 => by
        rw [hZ6, Function.update_of_ne h2, Function.update_of_ne h8, Function.update_of_ne h10,
          hZ3' i h0 h7]
    obtain ⟨t7, ht7, T', P', seg7⟩ := dz_runR κ (z := z) L6 Z6
      (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits b) (dzAlpha tail)) ([true] ++ z)) s₁ G
      (by rw [hL6]; simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h3])
      (by rw [hL6]; simp [hL4, hL3])
      (by rw [hL6, Function.update_self])
      (by rw [hL6]; simp [hL4, hL3, hL2, hL1, h12])
      (hZ6' 3 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
      (hZ6' 6 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
      (hZ6' 11 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
      (hZ6' 12 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
      T _ (by split_ifs <;> simp) hst hcut
    refine ⟨_, ?_, _, T', P', by split_ifs <;> simp, seg1.trans (seg2.trans (seg3.trans
      (seg4.trans (seg5.trans (seg6.trans seg7))))), fun hv => ?_, fun _ hCb hacc1 hacc2 => ?_⟩
    · have hα := κ.acL tail
      have hbb := length_bits_le_self b
      have hz := κ.hg z.length
      have hAa : κ.acA * (tail.length + 1) ≤ κ.acA * (κ.qcA * (G + 1)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
      unfold dzQB
      nlinarith
    · by_cases hacc : ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s₁.take b)
          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).state = none ∧
        ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s₁.take b)
          ((c.decode (dzAlpha tail)).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg ([true] ++ z))).output = [true]
      · exact ⟨hbG', hacc.1, hacc.2⟩
      · exfalso
        rw [if_neg hacc, if_neg (fun h => κ.hAJ h.2.symm)] at hv
        exact (dz_acc_ne_rej κ).symm hv
    · rw [if_pos (And.intro hacc1 hacc2), if_pos (And.intro (show T ≤ G by omega) rfl)]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega)] at seg4
    refine ⟨_, ?_, dzRej κ, _, _, Or.inr rfl, seg1.trans (seg2.trans (seg3.trans seg4)),
      fun hv => absurd hv (dz_acc_ne_rej κ).symm, fun h => absurd h hbG'⟩
    unfold dzQB
    nlinarith

/-! ### The diagonalizer `D` and its time bound -/

/-- **The diagonalizer** `D`: the guess-then-run host over the setup, the block tape, and the run,
entered at the flag, with its two verdicts, bundled as a finite nondeterministic machine. -/
private noncomputable def dzD {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) : FinNDTM Bool :=
  ⟨κ.K, Σ i, GuessRunPhase.State (Σ i, DzPPh κ i) (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) i,
    guessRunTM (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzAcc κ) (dzRej κ)⟩

/-- The diagonalizer's uniform constant: the setup's, the block's and the run's. -/
private def dzK {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) : ℕ :=
  (κ.qcA + κ.gcA + κ.pcA + 40) + (κ.qcA * (7 * κ.acA + 8) + 2 * κ.lcA + 140) + 15

/-- The setup's initial configuration is the blank seam in normal form. -/
private theorem dz_initCfg {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
    (dzSet κ).initCfg z =
      qyC ⟨.q, Sum.inl ()⟩ 1 (fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape []) (fun _ => 0) [] := by
  have hq : (dzSet κ).q₀ = ⟨.q, Sum.inl ()⟩ := phaseHostTM_q₀ _ _ _
  rw [initCfg_ofWords, hq]
  exact Cfg.ext (Cfg.ofWords_state _ _) (Cfg.ofWords_inputPos _ _)
    (funext fun j => Cfg.ofWords_workTapes _ _ j) (funext fun j => Cfg.ofWords_workTapePos _ _ j)
    (Cfg.ofWords_output _ _)

/-- A word longer than `G` is its first `G` symbols, one symbol and the rest. -/
private theorem dz_split_stream (s : List Bool) (G : ℕ) (h : G < s.length) :
    s = s.take G ++ [s[G]] ++ s.drop (G + 1) := by
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append, ← List.drop_eq_getElem_cons h,
    List.take_append_drop]

/-- **A segment's verdict.** A segment of the run, avoiding both verdicts, to a configuration in the
verdict `v` with nothing emitted: the run's state at its end is `v`, neither verdict is reached
earlier, and the output is empty. -/
private theorem dz_seg_read {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {z : List Bool} (st : Cfg κ.K Bool (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) z) (t : ℕ)
    (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ)
    (seg : Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True) st (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t) :
    ((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).state = some v ∧
      (∀ u < t, ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzAcc κ) ∧
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzRej κ)) ∧
      ((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).output = [] := by
  obtain ⟨hrun, havoid, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg
  refine ⟨by rw [hrun]; rfl, fun u hu => ⟨fun h => havoid u hu (by rw [h]; exact Or.inl rfl),
    fun h => havoid u hu (by rw [h]; exact Or.inr rfl)⟩, by rw [hrun]; rfl⟩

/-- **Every stream's run reaches a verdict** within `dzQB κ (g |z|)` steps, and none earlier: the
run's condition of `Turing.guessRunTM`'s lemmas.

**Proof sketch.** The entry configuration is the setup's layout with the stream on the block tape
(`dz_handoff`). Cases on the query: empty (`dz_qoff`), `true :: tail` (`dz_qtop`), `false :: tail`
(`dz_qmid`, the stream split as `s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w` with `|s₁| = g n`, `dz_split_stream`, and the
core's clause for `α = dzAlpha tail`). Each gives a segment to a verdict, avoiding both verdicts
before. -/
private theorem dz_hQ {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z s : List Bool) (hs : s.length = (dzBlk (g z.length)).length) :
    ∃ TQ ≤ dzQB κ (g z.length),
      (((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) TQ).state =
          some (dzAcc κ) ∨
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) TQ).state =
          some (dzRej κ)) ∧
      ∀ u < TQ,
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) u).state ≠
          some (dzAcc κ) ∧
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (guessRunCfg (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) (κ.tp 6) s ⟨.flag, none⟩) u).state ≠
          some (dzRej κ) := by
  rw [dz_handoff κ z s hs]
  have fin : ∀ (t : ℕ) (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ)
      (st : Cfg κ.K Bool (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) z), (v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ) →
      Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True) st (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t →
      (((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).state = some (dzAcc κ) ∨
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom st t).state = some (dzRej κ)) ∧
      ∀ u < t, ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzAcc κ) ∧
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzRej κ) := by
    intro t v T' P' st hv seg
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := dz_seg_read κ st t v T' P' seg
    rw [h1]
    exact ⟨hv.imp (congrArg some) (congrArg some), h2⟩
  rcases hq : query f g z with _ | ⟨b, tail⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, T', P', seg⟩ := dz_qoff κ z s hq
    exact ⟨t, ht, fin t _ T' P' _ (Or.inr rfl) seg⟩
  · cases b
    · have hlen : g z.length < s.length := by
        rw [hs, dzBlk_length]
        omega
      have hsplit := dz_split_stream s (g z.length) hlen
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := κ.hR (dzAlpha tail)
      have hw : (s.drop (g z.length + 1)).length = (Nat.bits (g z.length)).length := by
        rw [List.length_drop, hs, dzBlk_length]
        omega
      obtain ⟨t, ht, v, T', P', hv, seg, -, -⟩ := dz_qmid κ z tail hq C hC (s.take (g z.length))
        (s.drop (g z.length + 1)) s[g z.length] (by rw [List.length_take]; omega) hw
      rw [← hsplit] at seg
      exact ⟨t, ht, fin t v T' P' _ hv seg⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, v, T', P', hv, seg, -⟩ := dz_qtop κ z tail s hq
      exact ⟨t, ht, fin t v T' P' _ hv seg⟩

/-- The setup's facts for `Turing.guessRunTM`'s lemmas: its run to the exit, the exit's first
arrival, and the block, nonblank on its `|dzBlk (g n)|` cells from the head and blank on both
sides.

**Proof sketch.** `dz_setup`'s segment, read through `Turing.segment_iff` from the initial
configuration (`dz_initCfg`): its run gives the exit and its avoided set the first arrival. The
block tape holds `bufferTape (dzBlk (g n))` with its head at `0` (`dzLay_tp`), so its cells
`0, …, |dzBlk (g n)| - 1` are nonblank and the cells `-1` and `|dzBlk (g n)|` blank. -/
private theorem dz_setup_facts {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
    ∃ TP ≤ dzSetB κ (g z.length),
      (dzSet κ).runFrom ((dzSet κ).initCfg z) TP =
        qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) [] ∧
      (∀ u < TP, ((dzSet κ).runFrom ((dzSet κ).initCfg z) u).state ≠ some (dzPexit κ)) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, p < (dzBlk (g z.length)).length →
        (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0)
          []).workTapes (κ.tp 6) ((qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []).workTapePos (κ.tp 6) + p) ≠ none) ∧
      (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0)
          []).workTapes (κ.tp 6) ((qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []).workTapePos (κ.tp 6) +
          (dzBlk (g z.length)).length) = none ∧
      (qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0)
          []).workTapes (κ.tp 6) ((qyC (x := z) (dzPexit κ) 1 (dzLay (dzSetL f g z)
          (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []).workTapePos (κ.tp 6) - 1) = none := by
  obtain ⟨TP, hTP, seg⟩ := dz_setup κ z
  obtain ⟨hrun, havoid, -⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg
  have h6 : dzSetL f g z 6 = FinTM.bufferTape (dzBlk (g z.length)) := by simp [dzSetL]
  refine ⟨TP, hTP, by rw [dz_initCfg]; exact hrun, fun u hu h => havoid u hu ?_, fun p hp => ?_,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [dz_initCfg] at h
    rw [h]
    rfl
  · show dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape []) (κ.tp 6) (0 + p) ≠ none
    rw [dzLay_tp, h6, zero_add, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hp]
    exact Option.some_ne_none _
  · show dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape []) (κ.tp 6)
      (0 + ((dzBlk (g z.length)).length : ℤ)) = none
    rw [dzLay_tp, h6, zero_add, FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem _ (by omega)]
  · show dzLay (dzSetL f g z) (FinTM.bufferTape []) (κ.tp 6) (0 - 1) = none
    rw [dzLay_tp, h6, FinTM.bufferTape_eq_none_of_not_mem _ (by omega)]

/-- **The budget covers the branch**: `TP + 2m + T + 11 ≤ K (g n + 1)` for the setup's time
`TP ≤ dzSetB κ G`, the block's width `m = |dzBlk G|` and the run's bound `T = dzQB κ G`. -/
private theorem dz_K_bound {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (G TP : ℕ) (hTP : TP ≤ dzSetB κ G) :
    TP + 2 * (dzBlk G).length + dzQB κ G + 11 ≤ dzK κ * (G + 1) := by
  have hb := length_bits_le_self G
  rw [dzBlk_length]
  unfold dzSetB at hTP
  unfold dzK dzQB
  nlinarith

/-- **All-branch halting.** Every branch of `D` on every input `z` halts within
`K (g |z| + 1)`, `K = dzK κ` uniform.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.guessRunTM_haltsWithin` with the setup's facts (`dz_setup_facts`) and
every stream's verdict (`dz_hQ`) gives `TP + 2m + T + 11` with `TP ≤ dzSetB`, `m = g n + 1 +
|bits (g n)| ≤ 2 (g n + 1)` and `T ≤ dzQB`; `Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin.mono` reaches the bound. -/
private theorem dz_halts {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
    (dzD κ).tm.HaltsWithin z (dzK κ * (g z.length + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨TP, hTP, hP, hPfirst, hblock, hend, hleft⟩ := dz_setup_facts κ z
  have h := guessRunTM_haltsWithin (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩ (dzAcc κ)
    (dzRej κ) TP _ hP rfl hPfirst _ hblock hend hleft (dzQB κ (g z.length))
    (fun s hs => dz_hQ κ z s hs)
  exact h.mono (dz_K_bound κ _ TP hTP)

/-! ### The middle and the top -/

/-- **`D`'s acceptance, read on its streams.** `D` accepts `z` within `K (g |z| + 1)` iff some
stream as wide as the block makes the run's first verdict the acceptance, with nothing emitted.

**Proof sketch.** `Turing.FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff` and `Turing.guessRunTM_accepts_iff` at the
budget `K (g |z| + 1)`, which is at least `TP + 2m + T + 11` (as in `dz_halts`); the entry
configuration is `dz_handoff`'s. -/
private theorem dz_accepts_iff {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) (z : List Bool) :
    (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin z (dzK κ * (g z.length + 1)) ↔
      ∃ s : List Bool, s.length = (dzBlk (g z.length)).length ∧ ∃ TQ : ℕ,
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) TQ).state =
          some (dzAcc κ) ∧
        (∀ u < TQ,
          ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
            (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) u).state ≠
            some (dzAcc κ) ∧
          ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
            (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) u).state ≠
            some (dzRej κ)) ∧
        ((dzQ κ).runFrom (qyC (x := z) ⟨.flag, none⟩ 1 (dzLay (Function.update (dzSetL f g z) 6
          (FinTM.bufferTape s)) (FinTM.bufferTape [])) (fun _ => 0) []) TQ).output = [] := by
  obtain ⟨TP, hTP, hP, hPfirst, hblock, hend, hleft⟩ := dz_setup_facts κ z
  have hB := dz_K_bound κ _ TP hTP
  have h := guessRunTM_accepts_iff (dzSet κ) (dzPexit κ) (κ.tp 6) (dzQ κ) ⟨.flag, none⟩
    (dzAcc κ) (dzRej κ) TP _ hP rfl hPfirst _ hblock hend hleft (dzQB κ (g z.length))
    (fun s hs => dz_hQ κ z s hs) _ hB
  rw [FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff]
  refine h.trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, TQ, h1, h2, h3⟩
    rw [dz_handoff κ z s hs] at h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨s, hs, TQ, h1, h2, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, TQ, h1, h2, h3⟩
    refine ⟨s, hs, TQ, ?_⟩
    rw [dz_handoff κ z s hs]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

/-- **The first verdict is unique.** If the run's first verdict is the acceptance at `TQ`, and a
segment avoiding both verdicts reaches the verdict `v` at `t`, then `v` is the acceptance. -/
private theorem dz_first {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {z : List Bool} (st : Cfg κ.K Bool (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) z) (TQ t : ℕ)
    (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i) (T' : Fin κ.K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P' : Fin κ.K → ℤ)
    (hacc : ((dzQ κ).runFrom st TQ).state = some (dzAcc κ))
    (hcut : ∀ u < TQ, ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzAcc κ) ∧
      ((dzQ κ).runFrom st u).state ≠ some (dzRej κ))
    (hv : v = dzAcc κ ∨ v = dzRej κ)
    (seg : Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True) st (qyC v 1 T' P' []) t) : v = dzAcc κ := by
  have hq : Segment (dzQ κ) (dzQF κ) (fun _ => True) st ((dzQ κ).runFrom st TQ) TQ :=
    (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, fun u hu hmem => by
      rcases hmem with h | h
      · exact (hcut u hu).1 h
      · exact (hcut u hu).2 h, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
  have hvF : (qyC v 1 T' P' [] : Cfg κ.K Bool (Σ i, DzQPh κ i) z).state ∈ dzQF κ := by
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  have ht : t = TQ := Segment.time_eq seg hvF hq (Or.inl hacc)
  subst ht
  rw [(segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp seg |>.1] at hacc
  exact Option.some_inj.mp hacc

/-- The middle's query: on `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` off the stage's top, the query is `false` and the
pair `⟨⟨bits (g n), α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.query_eq`), `α` its stage's code, which the
extractor recovers (`dz_alpha_eq`). -/
private theorem dz_query_mid (f g : ℕ → ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hmid : n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1)) :
    query f g (List.replicate n true) = false :: pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n))
      (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (n + 1) true) := by
  rw [query_eq f g hn, if_neg hmid]

/-- `1^{n + 1}` is `true` prepended to `1ⁿ`. -/
private theorem dz_ones_succ (n : ℕ) :
    [true] ++ List.replicate n true = List.replicate (n + 1) true := by
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  rfl

/-- **The middle, soundness.** On `1ⁿ` off its stage's top, if `D` accepts within `K (g n + 1)`,
the code `α` of the stage accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `g n`.

**Proof sketch.** An accepting stream (`dz_accepts_iff`) splits as `s₁ ++ [sp] ++ w`
(`dz_split_stream`); its run's first verdict is `dz_qmid`'s (`dz_first`), so `b ≤ g n` and the
branch along `s₁.take b` halts with `[true]`: acceptance within `b`
(`Turing.FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff`), hence within `g n` (`Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin.mono`). -/
private theorem dz_mid_sound {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hmid : n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1))
    (h : (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (dzK κ * (g n + 1))) :
    (c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true)
      (g n) := by
  have hz : (List.replicate n true).length = n := List.length_replicate
  have hd := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mp (by rw [hz]; exact h)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, TQ, hacc, hcut, -⟩ := hd
  have hq := dz_query_mid f g hn hmid
  have hα : dzAlpha (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n)) (stageCode (stage f n)))
      (List.replicate (n + 1) true)) = stageCode (stage f n) := dz_alpha_eq _ _ _
  have hlen : g (List.replicate n true).length < s.length := by
    rw [hs, dzBlk_length]
    omega
  have hsplit := dz_split_stream s _ hlen
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := κ.hR (dzAlpha (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n))
    (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (n + 1) true)))
  have hw : (s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1)).length =
      (Nat.bits (g (List.replicate n true).length)).length := by
    rw [List.length_drop, hs, dzBlk_length]
    omega
  obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', hv, seg, hsound, -⟩ := dz_qmid κ (List.replicate n true) _ hq C hC
    (s.take (g (List.replicate n true).length)) (s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1))
    s[g (List.replicate n true).length] (by rw [List.length_take]; omega) hw
  rw [← hsplit] at seg
  obtain ⟨hbG, h1, h2⟩ := hsound (dz_first κ _ TQ t v T' P' hacc hcut hv seg)
  rw [hα, dz_ones_succ] at h1 h2
  have hbG' := hbG.trans (le_of_eq (congrArg g hz))
  have hlt : (List.take (Nat.ofDigits 2 ((s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1)).map
      Bool.toNat)) (s.take (g (List.replicate n true).length))).length =
      Nat.ofDigits 2 ((s.drop (g (List.replicate n true).length + 1)).map Bool.toNat) := by
    rw [List.length_take, List.length_take]
    omega
  exact (FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨_, hlt, h1, h2⟩).mono hbG'

/-- **The middle, completeness.** On `1ⁿ` off its stage's top, with the core's constant `C` for the
stage's code `α`: if `α` accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `t'` with `C (t' + 1) ≤ g n` and `t' ≤ g n`,
`D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K (g n + 1)`.

**Proof sketch.** Take the accepting word `v₀` (`Turing.FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff`), the stream
`v₀` padded with `false` to `g n` cells, any separator, and the budget word `bits t'` padded with
zeros to the width `|bits (g n)|` (`qy_bits_len_mono`), worth `t'` (`dz_padded_value`). The stream's
first `t'` bits are `v₀`, so `dz_qmid`'s completeness clause gives the acceptance, and its segment
gives `D`'s acceptance condition (`dz_seg_read`, `dz_accepts_iff`). -/
private theorem dz_mid_complete {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hmid : n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1)) (C : ℕ)
    (hC : ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (s : List Bool), t ≤ s.length →
      ∃ T, T ≤ C * (t + 1) ∧
        (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t)
            (stageCode (stage f n))) x) κ.jR κ.rE s) T).state =
          some (if ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
                ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
              ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.runWith (s.take t)
                ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]
            then κ.rA else κ.rJ) ∧
        ∀ u < T,
          (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t)
              (stageCode (stage f n))) x) κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rA ∧
            (κ.R.runFrom (streamStartCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t)
              (stageCode (stage f n))) x) κ.jR κ.rE s) u).state ≠ some κ.rJ)
    (t' : ℕ) (hacc : (c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
      (List.replicate (n + 1) true) t') (hCt : C * (t' + 1) ≤ g n) (ht' : t' ≤ g n) :
    (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (dzK κ * (g n + 1)) := by
  have hz : (List.replicate n true).length = n := List.length_replicate
  have hq := dz_query_mid f g hn hmid
  have hα : dzAlpha (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (g n)) (stageCode (stage f n)))
      (List.replicate (n + 1) true)) = stageCode (stage f n) := dz_alpha_eq _ _ _
  rw [← hα] at hC hacc
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀, h1, h2⟩ := FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mp hacc
  have hgz : g (List.replicate n true).length = g n := congrArg g hz
  set s₁ := v₀ ++ List.replicate (g n - t') false with hs₁
  set w := Nat.bits t' ++ List.replicate ((Nat.bits (g n)).length - (Nat.bits t').length) false
    with hw
  have hs₁l : s₁.length = g (List.replicate n true).length := by
    rw [hs₁, hgz, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
    omega
  have hwl : w.length = (Nat.bits (g (List.replicate n true).length)).length := by
    have := qy_bits_len_mono ht'
    rw [hw, hgz, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
    omega
  have hb : Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = t' := dz_padded_value _ _
  have htake : s₁.take t' = v₀ := by
    rw [hs₁, ← hv₀]
    exact List.take_left' rfl
  obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', -, seg, -, hcomp⟩ := dz_qmid κ (List.replicate n true) _ hq C hC s₁ w
    false hs₁l hwl
  rw [hb] at hcomp
  have hv := hcomp (by rw [hgz]; exact ht') (by rw [hgz]; exact hCt)
    (by rw [htake, dz_ones_succ]; exact h1) (by rw [htake, dz_ones_succ]; exact h2)
  subst hv
  have hfin := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mpr ⟨s₁ ++ [false] ++ w, by
    rw [dzBlk_length, List.length_append, List.length_append, hs₁l, hwl, List.length_singleton],
    t, dz_seg_read κ _ t _ T' P' seg⟩
  rwa [hz] at hfin

/-- **The top.** On `1ⁿ` at its stage's top, with `BF`'s constant `CB` for the stage's code `α`
(`hBF`'s clause at the stage's budget and bottom), when `CB 2^{CB (T* + 1)} ≤ g n`: `D` accepts
`1ⁿ` within `K (g n + 1)` iff `α` does not accept the bottom `1^{ℓ + 1}` within `T*`.

**Proof sketch.** The query is `true :: ⟨⟨bits T*, α⟩, 1^{ℓ + 1}⟩` (`Turing.NTimeDiag.query_eq`),
`hBF`'s input. `BF` computes `[b]`, `b` the acceptance's truth, by its time
`CB 2^{CB (T* + 1)} ≤ g n` (`Turing.FinTM.computesInTime_iff`), so every stream's run
(`dz_qtop`) accepts iff `b = false`. Forward: an accepting stream's first verdict is `dz_qtop`'s
(`dz_first`). Backward: any stream (the block itself) gives `D`'s acceptance condition
(`dz_seg_read`, `dz_accepts_iff`). -/
private theorem dz_top_iff {f g : ℕ → ℕ} {c : EffectiveNDMachineCode} {BF : FinTM Bool}
    (κ : DzKit f g c BF) {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (htop : n = ladder f (stage f n + 1)) (CB : ℕ)
    (hCB : ((c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
        (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))) →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))
          (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)) [true]
          (CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)))) ∧
      (¬(c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
        (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))) →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))
          (stageCode (stage f n))) (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)) [false]
          (CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)))))
    (hle : CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) ≤ g n) :
    (dzD κ).AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (dzK κ * (g n + 1)) ↔
      ¬(c.decode (stageCode (stage f n))).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
        (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))) := by
  have hz : (List.replicate n true).length = n := List.length_replicate
  have hgz : g (List.replicate n true).length = g n := congrArg g hz
  have hq : query f g (List.replicate n true) = true :: pairEncode (pairEncode
      (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
      (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true) := by
    rw [query_eq f g hn, if_pos htop]
  -- the decider's answer on the tail, inside the allowance
  have hans : ∀ b : Bool, BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode
      (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
      (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)) [b]
      (CB * 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1))) →
      ∀ (v : Σ i, DzQPh κ i), (∀ τ ≤ g (List.replicate n true).length,
        (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode
          (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
          (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true))) τ).state = none →
        (v = dzAcc κ ↔ (BF.tm.runFrom (BF.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode
          (Nat.bits (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)))) (stageCode (stage f n)))
          (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true))) τ).output.head? = some false)) →
      (v = dzAcc κ ↔ b = false) := by
    intro b hb v hsem
    obtain ⟨hst, hout⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hb
    rw [hsem _ (by rw [hgz]; exact hle) hst, hout]
    cases b <;> simp
  constructor
  · intro hD
    obtain ⟨s, hs, TQ, hacc, hcut, -⟩ := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mp
      (by rw [hz]; exact hD)
    obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', hv, seg, hsem⟩ := dz_qtop κ (List.replicate n true) _ s hq
    have hvacc := dz_first κ _ TQ t v T' P' hacc hcut hv seg
    intro hA
    have := (hans true (hCB.1 hA) v hsem).mp hvacc
    exact Bool.noConfusion this
  · intro hA
    obtain ⟨t, -, v, T', P', -, seg, hsem⟩ := dz_qtop κ (List.replicate n true) _
      (dzBlk (g (List.replicate n true).length)) hq
    have hv := (hans false (hCB.2 hA) v hsem).mpr rfl
    subst hv
    have hfin := (dz_accepts_iff κ (List.replicate n true)).mpr
      ⟨dzBlk (g (List.replicate n true).length), rfl, t, dz_seg_read κ _ t _ T' P' seg⟩
    rwa [hz] at hfin

/-- **The diagonalizer** ([AB09, proof of Theorem 3.2 and Figure 3.1]: the lazy diagonalization
over the stages above): for time-constructible `f`, `g`, an effective scheme `c` and a
deterministic decider of the coded machines' bounded acceptance in exponential time (`hBF`, the
conclusion of `Turing.exists_ndAcceptsWithin_decider`) there are a nondeterministic machine `D` and
a constant `K` with:
- every branch of `D` on every input `x` halts within `K · (g |x| + 1)`;
- for every code `α` a constant `C` such that, on `1ⁿ` with `n ≥ 3` in a stage of `α`:
  - in the middle (`n` not the stage's top): if `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K · (g n + 1)`, the coded
    machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` within `g n`; and if the coded machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` within
    some `t'` with `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`, `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within `K · (g n + 1)`;
  - at the top (`n = ℓᵢ₊₁`), when `C · 2^{C · (T* + 1)} ≤ n`: `D` accepts `1ⁿ` within
    `K · (g n + 1)` iff the coded machine does not accept the bottom `1^{ℓᵢ + 1}` within
    `T* = budget f ℓᵢ`.

**Why the decider is a hypothesis.** It is stated in
`TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeHierarchy`, whose `ntime_hierarchy` needs this module,
so this module cannot import it. That proof supplies it from
`Turing.exists_ndAcceptsWithin_decider`; taking it as a hypothesis keeps the two modules' imports
acyclic.

**Proof sketch.** `D` is assembled by the nondeterministic phase host
`Turing.NDTM.phaseHostND`:
- **query:** the stage query by `Turing.NTimeDiag.exists_queryTM`'s machine, called on the native
  input (`Turing.FinTM.exists_inputCallTM`);
- **guess:** `bits (g n)` by `g`'s witness, expanded to a block (`Turing.expandTM`), overwritten by
  the choice writer (`Turing.ndWriterTM_run_block`) and rewound: the stream `s`, with `|s| = g n`.
  In the middle, also a **nominal budget** `b` (C1's design §3.6, the fallback): a word of the
  width of `bits (g n)` from the choice writer, rejected unless its value is at most `g n`, and
  normalized to `bits b`;
- **middle:** the query word with its budget field rewritten from `bits (g n)` to `bits b`, that
  is `⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩`, run by the interpreter core `Turing.exists_ndInterpreterCore` with
  the stream `s` (`b ≤ |s|`), under the step clock (`Turing.exists_stepClockTMVia`) with the body
  allowance `g n` (its counter is `bits (g n)`), accepting iff the interpreter accepts in time;
- **top:** the exponential decider of `hBF` on the query word
  (hosted by `Turing.vhostSilentTM`), under the same clock, accepting iff it completes with
  `[false]`;
- default reject.

**Time.** Every phase before the simulators is code-independent and costs at most `P · (g n + 1)`
for a uniform `P`: the query, the stream, and the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite.
The clock runs a simulator for at most its body allowance, `g n` steps, at a physical cost of at
most `5 · g n + 2 · |bits (g n)| + 2 ≤ 7 · (g n + 1)`, and the final dispatch costs a constant `P'`.
So `K = P + 7 + P'` bounds every branch; the body allowance and `K` are distinct quantities.
- **Middle completeness:** if the coded machine accepts `1^{n + 1}` along a word of length `t'`
  with `C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n`, take `b = t'` and a stream whose first `t'` bits are that word. The
  interpreter's total-time clause, `T ≤ C_R · (b + 1)` with no `|x|` term, gives
  `T ≤ C · (t' + 1) ≤ g n` when `C ≥ C_R`: inside the allowance, with the verdict `accept`.
- **Middle soundness:** an accepting interpreter run is an accepting branch along `s.take b` (the
  replay lemma), and acceptance within `b ≤ g n` is acceptance within `g n`
  (`Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin.mono`). A guess `b` below every acceptance time sees no halted
  accepting branch and rejects.
- **Top:** the decider's time is `C_BF · 2^{C_BF · (T* + 1)} ≤ n ≤ g n`, inside the allowance.

The interpreter's prefix clause is not used: its `|x|` term (`|x| = n + 1`) carries the per-code
constant, which the uniform `K` cannot absorb when `g n = n`.

Fill obligations, named: the assembly; the budget's guess, test, normalization and rewrite (a
private leaf in `O(g n + 1)`); the transfer to every branch
(`Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn_det`); the clock's two exits per rung; the per-code
constant `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`.

**Implementation.** `D` is `Turing.guessRunTM` over a deterministic setup and a deterministic
run. The setup calls the stage query, `g`'s witness and `x ↦ true :: x` on the native input
(released input calls), and writes the block `1^{g n} ++ [true] ++ bits (g n)` (two expansions and
a copy), the ruler `1^{g n}` and the clock's counter `bits (g n)`. The guess overwrites the block
with a stream, a separator and a budget word. The run is a phase host: a one-cell take reads the
query's flag; in the middle it splits the block (a skip back, the lockstep walk over the ruler, a
take of the separator, a move of the budget word), tests the budget `b ≤ g n` (its expansion and
the length comparison with the stream), normalizes it to `bits b` (an install call), extracts `α`
from the query's tail (the install call of the composite pair extractor), writes the core's input
`⟨⟨bits b, α⟩, 1^{n + 1}⟩` by three emissions under the capture wrapper, and runs the interpreter
core under the step clock over the virtual-input host, accepting at its `accept` within the
allowance `g n`; at a top it runs the decider of `hBF` on the query's tail under the same clocked
host and accepts iff its captured output starts with `false`. All-branch halting is
`Turing.guessRunTM_haltsWithin` and acceptance `Turing.guessRunTM_accepts_iff`; `K` is uniform and,
per code, `C = max 1 (max C_R C_BF)`. -/
theorem exists_diagonalizer {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Complexity.TimeConstructible f)
    (hg : Complexity.TimeConstructible g) (c : EffectiveNDMachineCode)
    (hBF : ∃ BF : FinTM Bool, ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      ((c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [true]
          (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1)))) ∧
      (¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t →
        BF.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false]
          (C * 2 ^ (C * (t + 1))))) :
    ∃ (D : FinNDTM Bool) (K : ℕ),
      (∀ x : List Bool, D.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (g x.length + 1))) ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → stageCode (stage f n) = α →
        (n ≠ ladder f (stage f n + 1) →
          (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) →
            (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) (g n)) ∧
          (∀ t' : ℕ, (c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate (n + 1) true) t' →
            C * (t' + 1) ≤ g n →
            D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)))) ∧
        (n = ladder f (stage f n + 1) →
          C * 2 ^ (C * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) ≤ n →
          (D.AcceptsWithin (List.replicate n true) (K * (g n + 1)) ↔
            ¬(c.decode α).toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin
              (List.replicate (ladder f (stage f n) + 1) true)
              (budget f (ladder f (stage f n))))) := by
  obtain ⟨BF, hBF⟩ := hBF
  obtain ⟨κ⟩ := dz_kit_exists hf hg c BF
  refine ⟨dzD κ, dzK κ, fun x => dz_halts κ x, fun α => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨CR, hCR⟩ := κ.hR α
  obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := hBF α
  refine ⟨max 1 (max CR CB), fun n hn hα => ⟨fun hmid => ⟨fun hD => ?_, fun t' hacc hCt => ?_⟩,
    fun htop hprem => ?_⟩⟩
  · subst hα
    exact dz_mid_sound κ hn hmid hD
  · subst hα
    have hCR' : CR ≤ max 1 (max CR CB) := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have h1 : 1 ≤ max 1 (max CR CB) := le_max_left _ _
    have ht1 : t' + 1 ≤ max 1 (max CR CB) * (t' + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ h1
    exact dz_mid_complete κ hn hmid CR hCR t' hacc
      ((Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hCR').trans hCt) (by omega)
  · subst hα
    have hCB' : CB ≤ max 1 (max CR CB) := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hpow : 2 ^ (CB * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) ≤
        2 ^ (max 1 (max CR CB) * (budget f (ladder f (stage f n)) + 1)) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hCB')
    exact dz_top_iff κ hn htop CB (hCB _ _)
      (((Nat.mul_le_mul hCB' hpow).trans hprem).trans (κ.hg n))

end Turing.NTimeDiag
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi

import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Simulation
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Virtual-input layout for subroutine calls

When a logspace machine calls a decider on an input it cannot afford to write down, it
presents a *virtual input* assembled from pieces it does have: a part of its own input and
short words held on work tapes [AB09, proof of Lemma 4.17, Fig. 4.3]. This file fixes the
shape of such virtual inputs and the bookkeeping of a head walking over them, as pure list
and arithmetic facts; the machines that realize the walk are in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Sim` (a call's decider run on the virtual
input) with `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.CallReturn` and
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Call` (entry and return).

A virtual input is a list of *segments* `(w, d)`, a word `w` rendered doubled (`d = true`,
each bit written twice) or plain, joined by the separator `[false, true]`. With two
segments `[(x, true), (y, false)]` this is exactly `Turing.pairEncode x y`.

A head on the virtual input is described by its segment `s` and a *track position*
(`TPos`): the left end of the segment (the cell before its first rendered bit), a cell
`c` of the underlying word together with a parity bit (which of the two copies, for a
doubled segment), or its right end (the cell after its last rendered bit). The left end of
segment `s + 1` is the last separator bit of segment `s`'s separator and its right end the
first; the left end of segment `0` and the right end of the last segment are the two
blank cells around the virtual input.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.vword` — the virtual input of a segment list.
* `Complexity.LogProg.vpos` — the (shifted, as in `Turing.Cfg.inputPos`) virtual position
  of a track position.
* `Complexity.LogProg.tmove` — the track position after a head move.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.vpos_tmove` — `tmove` implements the clamped input-head move of the
  machine model on the virtual input.
* `Complexity.LogProg.inputSymbol_vpos` — the symbol read at a track position.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, proof of Lemma 4.17.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

-- The doubling `Turing.dbl`, `Turing.getElem?_dbl` and `Turing.pairEncode_eq_dbl` live in
-- `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding`.

/-- A segment of a virtual input: a word, and whether it is rendered doubled. -/
abbrev Seg := List Bool × Bool

/-- The rendering of a segment. -/
def render (s : Seg) : List Bool := if s.2 then dbl s.1 else s.1

/-- The length of the rendering of a segment. -/
def rlen (s : Seg) : ℕ := if s.2 then 2 * s.1.length else s.1.length

/-- A doubled segment renders to twice its word's length. -/
@[simp] lemma rlen_true (w : List Bool) : rlen (w, true) = 2 * w.length := rfl
/-- A plain segment renders to its word's length. -/
@[simp] lemma rlen_false (w : List Bool) : rlen (w, false) = w.length := rfl

/-- The rendering of a segment has length `rlen`. -/
@[simp] lemma length_render (s : Seg) : (render s).length = rlen s := by
  unfold render rlen; split <;> simp

/-- The virtual input of a nonempty segment list: the renderings joined by `[false, true]`. -/
def vword : List Seg → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | [s] => render s
  | s :: t :: rest => render s ++ [false, true] ++ vword (t :: rest)

/-- The offset of segment `i` in the virtual input. -/
def off : List Seg → ℕ → ℕ
  | _, 0 => 0
  | [], _ + 1 => 0
  | s :: rest, i + 1 => rlen s + 2 + off rest i

/-- Segment `i`, with a default beyond the list. -/
def seg (segs : List Seg) (i : ℕ) : Seg := segs.getD i ([], false)

/-- The segment `0` of `s :: rest` is `s`. -/
@[simp] lemma seg_cons_zero (s : Seg) (rest : List Seg) : seg (s :: rest) 0 = s := rfl
/-- The segment `i + 1` of `s :: rest` is segment `i` of `rest`. -/
@[simp] lemma seg_cons_succ (s : Seg) (rest : List Seg) (i : ℕ) :
    seg (s :: rest) (i + 1) = seg rest i := rfl

/-- The next offset is past the segment and its separator. -/
lemma off_succ (segs : List Seg) (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < segs.length) :
    off segs (i + 1) = off segs i + rlen (seg segs i) + 2 := by
  induction segs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons s rest ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [off]
    | succ i =>
      simp only [off, seg_cons_succ]
      rw [ih i (by simp at hi; omega)]
      ring

/-- The virtual input ends with the last segment. -/
lemma length_vword (segs : List Seg) (h : segs ≠ []) :
    (vword segs).length = off segs (segs.length - 1) + rlen (seg segs (segs.length - 1)) := by
  induction segs with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons s rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp [vword, off, seg]
    | cons t rest' =>
      have := ih (by simp)
      simp only [vword, List.length_append, length_render, List.length_cons] at this ⊢
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, off, seg_cons_succ]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
      rw [this]
      cases rest'.length <;> simp [off]; ring

/-- Inside segment `i`, the virtual input reads the segment's rendering: cell `off segs i + k` holds
letter `k` of `render (seg segs i)`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the segment list: segment `0` is the start of the virtual input,
and segment `i + 1` is segment `i` of the rest after the first rendering and its separator,
whose length shifts the offset. -/
lemma getElem?_vword_seg (segs : List Seg) (i k : ℕ) (hi : i < segs.length)
    (hk : k < rlen (seg segs i)) :
    (vword segs)[off segs i + k]? = (render (seg segs i))[k]? := by
  induction segs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons s rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      have : i = 0 := by simp at hi; omega
      subst this; simp [vword, off]
    | cons t rest' =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        simp only [vword, off, seg_cons_zero, Nat.zero_add] at hk ⊢
        rw [List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hk)]
      | succ i =>
        simp only [vword, off, seg_cons_succ] at hk ⊢
        rw [show rlen s + 2 + off (t :: rest') i + k = (render s ++ [false, true]).length +
          (off (t :: rest') i + k) by simp; ring, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp)]
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        exact ih i (by simp at hi ⊢; omega) hk

/-- The separator `0 1` after segment `i` of a virtual input sits right after that segment's
rendering.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the segment list: for `i = 0` the virtual input is the first
rendering followed by `[false, true]`; for `i + 1` drop the first rendering and its separator,
shifting the offsets by their length. -/
lemma getElem?_vword_sep (segs : List Seg) (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < segs.length) :
    (vword segs)[off segs i + rlen (seg segs i)]? = some false ∧
    (vword segs)[off segs i + rlen (seg segs i) + 1]? = some true := by
  induction segs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons s rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp at hi
    | cons t rest' =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        simp only [vword, off, seg_cons_zero, Nat.zero_add]
        constructor
        · rw [List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp)]; simp
        · rw [List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp)]; simp
      | succ i =>
        simp only [vword, off, seg_cons_succ]
        have h := ih i (by simp at hi ⊢; omega)
        constructor
        · rw [show rlen s + 2 + off (t :: rest') i + rlen (seg (t :: rest') i) =
            (render s ++ [false, true]).length + (off (t :: rest') i +
              rlen (seg (t :: rest') i)) by simp; ring, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp)]
          simpa using h.1
        · rw [show rlen s + 2 + off (t :: rest') i + rlen (seg (t :: rest') i) + 1 =
            (render s ++ [false, true]).length + (off (t :: rest') i +
              rlen (seg (t :: rest') i) + 1) by simp; ring,
            List.getElem?_append_right (by simp)]
          simpa using h.2

/-! ## Track positions -/

/-- A position of a head on a segment: its left end, a cell of the underlying word with a
parity (the copy, for doubled segments), or its right end. -/
inductive TPos where
  | left
  | cell (c : ℕ) (p : Bool)
  | right
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The underlying word length of segment `s`. -/
def wlen (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) : ℕ := (seg segs s).1.length

/-- A track position is valid when its cell lies in the word. -/
def TPos.Valid (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) : TPos → Prop
  | .cell c _ => c < wlen segs s
  | _ => True

/-- The rendered offset of a cell inside its segment. -/
def cellOff (segs : List Seg) (s c : ℕ) (p : Bool) : ℕ :=
  if (seg segs s).2 then 2 * c + p.toNat else c

/-- The virtual position (`inputPos`-style: `0` is the left blank, cell `j` of the virtual
input is position `j + 1`) of a track position. -/
def vpos (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) : TPos → ℕ
  | .left => off segs s
  | .cell c p => off segs s + 1 + cellOff segs s c p
  | .right => off segs s + 1 + rlen (seg segs s)

/-- The rendered offset of a cell of a segment's word lies within the segment's rendering. -/
lemma cellOff_lt (segs : List Seg) (s c : ℕ) (p : Bool) (hc : c < wlen segs s) :
    cellOff segs s c p < rlen (seg segs s) := by
  unfold cellOff rlen
  unfold wlen at hc
  generalize seg segs s = sg at *
  obtain ⟨w, d⟩ := sg
  cases d <;> cases p <;> simp at hc ⊢ <;> omega

/-- The track position after a head move by `m` (`tmove`'s first component is the new
segment). -/
def tmove (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) : TPos → SignType → ℕ × TPos
  | tp, .zero => (s, tp)
  | .cell c p, .pos =>
    if (seg segs s).2 ∧ p = false then (s, .cell c true)
    else if c + 1 < wlen segs s then (s, .cell (c + 1) false) else (s, .right)
  | .cell c p, .neg =>
    if (seg segs s).2 ∧ p = true then (s, .cell c false)
    else if c = 0 then (s, .left) else (s, .cell (c - 1) true)
  | .right, .pos => if s + 1 < segs.length then (s + 1, .left) else (s, .right)
  | .right, .neg => if wlen segs s = 0 then (s, .left) else (s, .cell (wlen segs s - 1) true)
  | .left, .pos => if wlen segs s = 0 then (s, .right) else (s, .cell 0 false)
  | .left, .neg => if s = 0 then (s, .left) else (s - 1, .right)

/-- `tmove` preserves validity and the segment bound. -/
lemma tmove_valid (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < segs.length) (tp : TPos)
    (htp : tp.Valid segs s) (m : SignType) :
    (tmove segs s tp m).1 < segs.length ∧
      (tmove segs s tp m).2.Valid segs (tmove segs s tp m).1 := by
  cases m <;> cases tp <;> simp only [tmove] <;> (try split_ifs) <;>
    simp_all [TPos.Valid] <;> omega

/-- The virtual input's length in terms of the last segment. -/
lemma vpos_right_last (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) (hs : s + 1 = segs.length) :
    vpos segs s .right = (vword segs).length + 1 := by
  rw [length_vword segs (by rintro rfl; simp at hs)]
  simp only [vpos, show segs.length - 1 = s by omega]
  ring

/-- Every segment ends inside the virtual input. -/
lemma off_add_rlen_le (segs : List Seg) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < segs.length) :
    off segs j + rlen (seg segs j) ≤ (vword segs).length := by
  induction segs generalizing j with
  | nil => simp at hj
  | cons s rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      have : j = 0 := by simp at hj; omega
      subst this; simp [vword, off]
    | cons t rest' =>
      cases j with
      | zero => simp [vword, off]
      | succ j =>
        have := ih j (by simp at hj ⊢; omega)
        simp only [vword, off, seg_cons_succ, List.length_append, length_render,
          List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at this ⊢
        omega

/-- The clamped input move, numerically. -/
lemma moveInputPos_val (N p : ℕ) (hp : p < N + 2) (m : SignType) :
    (moveInputPos (n := N) ⟨p, hp⟩ m).val =
      match m with
      | .zero => p
      | .pos => min (p + 1) (N + 1)
      | .neg => p - 1 := by
  cases m <;> simp only [moveInputPos, SignType.zero_eq_zero, SignType.coe_zero,
    SignType.pos_eq_one, SignType.coe_one, SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, SignType.coe_neg_one] <;>
    split <;> simp_all <;> omega

/-- `tmove` implements the clamped head move: the virtual position after the move is the
old one moved by `m`, clamped to `[0, |V| + 1]`.

**Proof sketch.** Case analysis on the track position and the move. Inside a word the
rendered offset changes by one (doubled segments switch copies before cells). From an end
of a segment the head passes to the neighbouring separator bit, which is the opposite end
of the neighbouring segment (`off_succ`); the outermost ends clamp (`vpos_right_last`). -/
lemma vpos_tmove (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < segs.length) (tp : TPos)
    (htp : tp.Valid segs s) (m : SignType) (hlt : vpos segs s tp < (vword segs).length + 2) :
    vpos segs (tmove segs s tp m).1 (tmove segs s tp m).2 =
      (moveInputPos (n := (vword segs).length) ⟨vpos segs s tp, hlt⟩ m).val := by
  rw [moveInputPos_val]
  have F1 := off_add_rlen_le segs s hs
  have F2 : s + 1 < segs.length → off segs (s + 1) = off segs s + rlen (seg segs s) + 2 ∧
      off segs (s + 1) + rlen (seg segs (s + 1)) ≤ (vword segs).length := fun h =>
    ⟨off_succ segs s h, off_add_rlen_le segs (s + 1) h⟩
  have F3 : s + 1 = segs.length → off segs s + rlen (seg segs s) = (vword segs).length := by
    intro h; have := vpos_right_last segs s h; simp only [vpos] at this; omega
  have F4 : 0 < s → off segs s = off segs (s - 1) + rlen (seg segs (s - 1)) + 2 := by
    intro h
    have := off_succ segs (s - 1) (by omega)
    rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel h] at this
  have F5 : 0 < s → off segs (s - 1) + rlen (seg segs (s - 1)) ≤ (vword segs).length :=
    fun h => off_add_rlen_le segs (s - 1) (by omega)
  unfold TPos.Valid at htp
  generalize hsg : seg segs s = sg at *
  obtain ⟨w, d⟩ := sg
  unfold wlen at htp
  rw [hsg] at htp
  dsimp only at htp
  cases m with
  | zero => simp only [tmove]
  | pos =>
    cases tp with
    | left =>
      simp only [tmove, wlen, hsg]
      split_ifs with h <;>
        cases d <;> simp only [vpos, cellOff, rlen_true, rlen_false, hsg, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true,
          Bool.toNat_false] at * <;> omega
    | cell c p =>
      simp only [tmove, wlen, hsg]
      split_ifs with h1 h2 <;>
        cases d <;> cases p <;> simp only [vpos, cellOff, rlen_true, rlen_false, hsg, ↓reduceIte,
          Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, and_true,
          and_false, not_true, not_false_eq_true] at * <;> omega
    | right =>
      simp only [tmove]
      split_ifs with h
      · obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := F2 h
        simp only [vpos]
        rw [e1]
        cases d <;> simp only [vpos, rlen_true, rlen_false, hsg] at * <;>
          omega
      · have := F3 (by omega)
        cases d <;> simp only [vpos, rlen_true, rlen_false, hsg] at * <;>
          omega
  | neg =>
    cases tp with
    | left =>
      simp only [tmove]
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h; simp [vpos, off]
      · have e := F4 (by omega)
        simp only [vpos] at hlt ⊢
        rw [e]
        omega
    | cell c p =>
      simp only [tmove, hsg]
      split_ifs with h1 h2 <;>
        cases d <;> cases p <;> simp only [vpos, cellOff, rlen_true, rlen_false, hsg, ↓reduceIte,
          Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.toNat_false, Bool.toNat_true, and_true,
          and_false, not_true, not_false_eq_true] at * <;> omega
    | right =>
      simp only [tmove, wlen, hsg]
      split_ifs with h <;>
        cases d <;> simp only [vpos, cellOff, rlen_true, rlen_false, hsg, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true,
          Bool.toNat_true] at * <;> omega

/-- The symbol of the virtual input at a track position. -/
def vsym (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) : TPos → Option Bool
  | .left => if s = 0 then none else some true
  | .cell c _ => (seg segs s).1[c]?
  | .right => if s + 1 < segs.length then some false else none

/-- The input symbol read at a configuration whose input head is at a track position is
`vsym`.

**Proof sketch.** Unfold the input symbol at position `vpos segs s tp`. A cell position falls
inside segment `s`'s rendering (`cellOff_lt`), giving its letter. A left or right blank position
falls on the end marker, on the separator `0 1` (`getElem?_vword_sep`) or past the end, which is
`vsym`'s case split. -/
lemma inputSymbol_vpos {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (segs : List Seg) (s : ℕ) (hs : s < segs.length)
    (tp : TPos) (htp : tp.Valid segs s) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S (vword segs))
    (hpos : cfg.inputPos.val = vpos segs s tp) : cfg.inputSymbol = vsym segs s tp := by
  have hgen : ∀ j, cfg.inputPos.val = j + 1 → j ≤ (vword segs).length →
      cfg.inputSymbol = (vword segs)[j]? := fun j hj hl => FinTM.inputSymbol_at cfg j hl hj
  have hlt := cfg.inputPos.isLt
  cases tp with
  | left =>
    simp only [vpos, vsym] at hpos ⊢
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      have hz : cfg.inputPos = 0 := Fin.ext (by simpa [off] using hpos)
      simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, hz]
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, s = j + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [off_succ segs j hs] at hpos
      rw [hgen (off segs j + rlen (seg segs j) + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
      exact (getElem?_vword_sep segs j hs).2
  | cell c p =>
    simp only [TPos.Valid, wlen] at htp
    simp only [vpos, vsym] at hpos ⊢
    have hc := cellOff_lt segs s c p htp
    rw [hgen (off segs s + cellOff segs s c p) (by omega) (by omega),
      getElem?_vword_seg segs s _ hs hc]
    unfold cellOff render
    split
    · exact (getElem?_dbl _ c htp p).trans (List.getElem?_eq_getElem htp).symm
    · rfl
  | right =>
    simp only [vpos, vsym] at hpos ⊢
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [hgen (off segs s + rlen (seg segs s)) (by omega) (by omega)]
      exact (getElem?_vword_sep segs s h).1
    · have hl : s + 1 = segs.length := by omega
      have := vpos_right_last segs s hl
      simp only [vpos] at this
      have hz : cfg.inputPos.val = (vword segs).length + 1 := by omega
      have hne : cfg.inputPos ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0] at hz; simp at hz
      simp [Cfg.inputSymbol, hne, hz]

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Machines/Program.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import Mathlib.Tactic.DeriveFintype
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sigma
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Sum
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Option
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Layout

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
