  refine (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).2 ⟨hend, fun u hu => ?_, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  · rw [hpre u (by omega), Cfg.mapState_state]
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hy
    exact hi (congrArg Sigma.fst hz)
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u (t + 1) with hu' | hu'
    · rw [hpre u (by omega), cw_mapState_pos]
      exact hB u (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : u = t + 1 := by omega
      rw [hend, cw_mapState_pos, ← h]
      exact hB t le_rfl

/-- **A row moving one head**, as a host segment. The row of phase `i` runs from the writer
configuration with control `s` to its anchor `v` in `t` steps, moving only the head of tape
`k₀`, within `[lo k₀, up k₀]`; its endpoint is the writer configuration with offsets `a'` and
`b'`, and the redirect continues at `q`. -/
private lemma cw_seg_row {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (i : cw_Idx c m)
    (hi : i ≠ .stop) {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (s v : cw_Ctrl P i) (q : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i)
    (hdone : ∀ z, cw_red en ex i z = if z = v then some q else none)
    (a a' : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b b' : ℤ) (t r : ℕ) (k₀ : Fin (K + 2)) (w : ℤ)
    (lo up : Fin (K + 2) → ℤ)
    (h₁ : (cw_rows e R i).runFrom (cw_cfg e d s a n b) t =
      { cw_cfg e d s a n b with
        state := some v
        workTapePos := Function.update (cw_cfg e d s a n b).workTapePos k₀ w })
    (hend : ({ cw_cfg e d s a n b with
        state := some v
        workTapePos := Function.update (cw_cfg e d s a n b).workTapePos k₀ w } :
        Cfg (K + 2) Γ (cw_Ctrl P i) x) = cw_cfg e d v a' n b')
    (h₂ : ∀ u < t, ((cw_rows e R i).runFrom (cw_cfg e d s a n b) u).state ≠ some v)
    (h₃ : ∀ (j : Fin (K + 2)) (u : ℕ), u ≤ t →
      if j = k₀ then ((cw_rows e R i).runFrom (cw_cfg e d s a n b) u).workTapePos j ∈
          Finset.Icc (lo j) (up j)
      else ((cw_rows e R i).runFrom (cw_cfg e d s a n b) u).workTapePos j =
        (cw_cfg e d s a n b).workTapePos j)
    (hrange : d.workTapePos k₀ - r ≤ lo k₀ ∧ up k₀ ≤ d.workTapePos k₀ + r)
    (ha : |a| ≤ r) (hb : |b| ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r) (cw_cfg e d (⟨i, s⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a n b)
      (cw_cfg e d q a' n b') (t + 1) := by
  have hseg := cw_seg e R en ex i hi _ _ t (h₁.trans hend) v rfl q (by rw [hdone, if_pos rfl])
    (cw_guard e R en ex i _ t v h₂ fun z hz => by rw [hdone, if_neg hz]) (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
    (fun u hu => cw_box_row _ _ _ _ _ r k₀ (fun j => h₃ j u hu) hrange
      (cw_cfg_box e d s a n b r ha hb))
  simp only [cw_cfg_mapState] at hseg
  exact hseg


/-- **The copy of a field onto the clock**, as a host segment: the clock gains `|f|` cells of
`e` at its head, which stays. The field `f` lies at the record head moved by `a`.
**Proof sketch.** The constant copy's endpoint patches the clock at its head; joined to the
clock's earlier patch it is the longer patch. -/
private lemma cw_seg_copy {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    (j : Fin m) {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (f : List Γ) (a : ℤ) (n n' r : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (f.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a + z) = FinTM.bufferTape f z)
    (hn' : n' = n + f.length) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (har : a + f.length ≤ r) (hnr : n' + 1 ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.copy p j, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a n n)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.skipS p j, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a n' n)
      (2 * f.length + 2 + 1) := by
  subst hn'
  let a₀ : Cfg (K + 2) Γ SweepPhase x := cw_cfg e d SweepPhase.sweep a n n
  have hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (f.length : ℤ) →
      a₀.workTapes 0 (a₀.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape f z := by
    intro z hz₁ hz₂
    rw [cw_cfg_tape e d _ a n n 0 (cw_zero_ne_last K), cw_cfg_pos₀]
    exact hf z hz₁ hz₂
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ :=
    cw_copy_constant 0 (Fin.last (K + 1)) (cw_zero_ne_last K) e f a₀ rfl hw
  have hend : (copyMapTM (K + 2) 0 (Fin.last (K + 1)) (fun _ => ()) (fun _ _ => e)).runFrom
      a₀ (2 * f.length + 2) = cw_cfg e d SweepPhase.done a (n + f.length) n := by
    rw [h₁]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ rfl rfl
    funext j z
    by_cases hj : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
    · subst hj
      show (if Fin.last (K + 1) = Fin.last (K + 1) then _ else _) = _
      rw [if_pos rfl, cw_cfg_clockTape, cw_cfg_clockTape, cw_cfg_posL, cw_join]
    · show (if j = Fin.last (K + 1) then _ else _) = _
      rw [if_neg hj, cw_cfg_tape e d _ a n n j hj, cw_cfg_tape e d _ a (n + f.length) n j hj]
  have hseg := cw_seg e R en ex (.copy p j) (by simp) a₀ _ _ hend SweepPhase.done rfl
    ⟨.skipS p j, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ (by rw [cw_red, if_pos rfl])
    (cw_guard e R en ex (.copy p j) a₀ _ _ h₂ fun z hz => by rw [cw_red, if_neg hz])
    (cw_box d.workTapePos r) (fun u hu => by
      have hr₀ := h₃ 0 u hu
      have hrL := h₃ (Fin.last (K + 1)) u hu
      rw [if_pos (Or.inl rfl), Finset.mem_Icc, cw_cfg_pos₀] at hr₀
      rw [if_pos (Or.inr rfl), Finset.mem_Icc, cw_cfg_posL] at hrL
      refine cw_box_of _ _ r (a - 1) (a + f.length) (n - 1) (n + f.length)
        (by omega) (by omega) (fun j h₀ hL => ?_) (by omega)
      have hrj := h₃ j u hu
      rw [if_neg (by tauto), cw_cfg_pos e d _ a n n j h₀ hL] at hrj
      exact hrj)
  simp only [a₀, cw_cfg_mapState] at hseg
  exact hseg

/-- **The skip past a field on the record tape**, as a host segment.
**Proof sketch.** The framed skip over the field, whose right delimiter is the record's
separator; nothing else moves. -/
private lemma cw_seg_skipS {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    (j : Fin m) {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (f : List Γ) (a a' : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (r : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z → z ≤ (f.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a + z) = FinTM.bufferTape f z)
    (ha' : a' = a + f.length + 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (har : a' ≤ r) (hbr : |b| ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.skipS p j, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a n b)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.skipC (some (p, j)), (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a' n b)
      (f.length + 1 + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg 0 f (cw_cfg e d SeekPhase.run a n b) rfl
    fun z hz₁ hz₂ => by
      rw [cw_cfg_tape e d _ a n b 0 (cw_zero_ne_last K), cw_cfg_pos₀]
      exact hf z hz₁ hz₂
  exact cw_seg_row e R en ex (.skipS p j) (by simp) d SeekPhase.run SeekPhase.done _
    (fun _ => rfl) a a' n b b _ r 0 _
    _ _ h₁ (cw_cfg_move₀ e d _ _ a n b _ a' (by rw [cw_cfg_pos₀]; omega)) h₂ h₃
    (by rw [cw_cfg_pos₀]; omega) (by rw [abs_of_nonneg ha]; omega) hbr

/-- The written cells after the clock head, then a blank: the word under the clock head; with
the head at the clock's start, the blank before it too.
**Proof sketch.** The cells after the head are inside the constant patch up to its end; the
cells around it were blank before the writer. -/
private lemma cw_skip_word {K : ℕ} {Γ P S : Type} {x : List Γ} (e : Γ)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (q : S)
    (a : ℤ) (N b l : ℕ) (hN : N = b + l) :
    ∀ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∨ b = 0 ∧ -1 ≤ z → z ≤ ((List.replicate l e).length : ℤ) →
      (cw_cfg e d q a N b).workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1))
          ((cw_cfg e d q a N b).workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + z) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate l e) z := by
  intro z hz₁ hz₂
  rw [List.length_replicate] at hz₂
  rw [cw_cfg_clock, cw_cfg_posL, cw_buffer_rep]
  by_cases hz : 0 ≤ z ∧ z < l
  · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos hz]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg hz, hclk]

/-- **The skip past the written cells on the clock**, as a host segment: the clock head
stops one cell past the clock's right delimiter. After a field (`some (p, j)`) the move back
onto the delimiter follows; after the last pass (`none`, with nothing left to skip) the skip
back over the clock word. -/
private lemma cw_seg_skipC {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ}
    (o : Option (Fin c × Fin m)) {x : List Γ}
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (a : ℤ) (N b l : ℕ) (hN : N = b + l)
    (b' : ℤ) (hb' : b' = b + l + 1) (r : ℕ) (har : |a| ≤ r) (hbr : b' ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.skipC o, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a N b)
      (cw_cfg e d (cw_afterSkip o) a N b') (l + 1 + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := skipTM_run_ofCfg (Fin.last (K + 1)) _ _ rfl
    fun z h₀ hz => cw_skip_word e d hclk SeekPhase.run a N b l hN z (Or.inl h₀) hz
  rw [List.length_replicate] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact cw_seg_row e R en ex (.skipC o) (by simp) d SeekPhase.run SeekPhase.done _
    (fun _ => rfl) a a N b b' _ r _ _ _
    _ h₁ (cw_cfg_moveL e d _ _ a _ b _ b' (by rw [cw_cfg_posL]; omega)) h₂ h₃
    (by rw [cw_cfg_posL]; omega) har (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; omega)

/-- **The one-cell move back onto the clock's delimiter**, as a host segment, followed by the
next field's copy or, after the last field, the record's rewind. -/
private lemma cw_seg_left {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    (j : Fin m) {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (a : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b b' : ℤ) (hb' : b' = b - 1) (r : ℕ) (har : |a| ≤ r) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hbr : b ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.left p j, false⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a n b)
      (cw_cfg e d (cw_next p j) a n b') (1 + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := cw_left_run (Fin.last (K + 1)) (cw_cfg e d false a n b) rfl
  have hend : (cw_leftTM (K + 2) (Fin.last (K + 1))).runFrom (cw_cfg e d false a n b) 1 =
      cw_cfg e d true a n b' :=
    h₁.trans (cw_cfg_moveL e d _ _ a n b _ b' (by rw [cw_cfg_posL]; omega))
  have hseg := cw_seg e R en ex (.left p j) (by simp) _ _ _ hend true rfl (cw_next p j)
    (by rw [cw_red, if_pos rfl])
    (cw_guard e R en ex (.left p j) _ _ _ h₂ fun z hz => by rw [cw_red, if_neg hz])
    (cw_box d.workTapePos r) (fun u hu => by
      rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hu with rfl | rfl
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
        exact cw_cfg_box e d _ a n b r har (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]; exact hbr)
      · rw [hend]
        exact cw_cfg_box e d _ a n b' r har (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]; omega))
  simp only [cw_cfg_mapState] at hseg
  exact hseg

/-- A segment's length may be restated. -/
private lemma cw_seg_time {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} {M : MultiTapeTM k Γ S}
    {F : Set (Option S)} {B : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop} {a b : Cfg k Γ S x} {t t' : ℕ}
    (h : Segment M F B a b t) (ht : t = t') : Segment M F B a b t' :=
  ht ▸ h

/-- Field `i` of a record at the head of tape `r` is a delimited word at its offset. -/
private lemma cw_field {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (r : Fin K)
    (rs : List (List Γ)) (hrs : RecordAt d r rs) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < rs.length) :
    ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (rs[i].length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes r (d.workTapePos r + fieldOffset rs i + z) = FinTM.bufferTape rs[i] z := by
  intro z hz₁ hz₂
  have hcell := (recordAt_iff d r rs).1 hrs (fieldOffset rs i + z)
    (by omega) (by have := fieldOffset_add_length_le rs i hi; omega)
  rw [← add_assoc] at hcell
  rw [hcell]
  exact fieldsTape_field rs i hi z hz₁ hz₂

/-- **One field's round**: the constant copy of field `j` onto the clock at its head, the skips
past the field on the record tape and past the written cells on the clock, and the move back
onto the clock's delimiter. The clock gains `|fs[j]|` cells of `e`, joined to the earlier ones,
and its head moves past them; the record head moves to the next field; nothing else changes.
**Proof sketch.** Concatenate the four phase segments; the record's field `j` is a delimited
word at its offset. -/
private lemma cw_round {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    {x : List Γ} (fs : List (List Γ)) (hfs : fs.length = m)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x) (hrec : RecordAt d 0 fs)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < fs.length)
    (n r : ℕ) (hnr : n + fs[j].length + 1 ≤ r) (hor : fieldOffset fs (j + 1) ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.copy p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ :
        Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) (fieldOffset fs j) n n)
      (cw_cfg e d (cw_next p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩) (fieldOffset fs (j + 1)) (n + fs[j].length)
        ((n + fs[j].length : ℕ) : ℤ)) (4 * fs[j].length + 9) := by
  have hoff := fieldOffset_succ fs j hj
  have hfield := cw_field d 0 fs hrec j hj
  have hor' : ((fieldOffset fs (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hor
  have habs : |((fieldOffset fs (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)| ≤ r := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact hor'
  have s₁ := cw_seg_copy e R en ex p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩ d fs[j] (fieldOffset fs j) n
    (n + fs[j].length) r hfield rfl (by positivity) (by omega) (by omega)
  have s₂ := cw_seg_skipS e R en ex p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩ d fs[j] (fieldOffset fs j)
    (fieldOffset fs (j + 1)) (n + fs[j].length) n r
    (fun z hz₁ hz₂ => hfield z (by omega) hz₂) (by omega) (by positivity) hor'
    (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; omega)
  have s₃ := cw_seg_skipC e R en ex (some (p, ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩)) d hclk (fieldOffset fs (j + 1))
    (n + fs[j].length) n fs[j].length rfl ((n : ℤ) + fs[j].length + 1) rfl r habs (by omega)
  have s₄ := cw_seg_left e R en ex p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩ d (fieldOffset fs (j + 1))
    (n + fs[j].length) ((n : ℤ) + fs[j].length + 1) ((n + fs[j].length : ℕ) : ℤ)
    (by push_cast; ring) r habs (by omega) (by omega)
  exact cw_seg_time (s₁.trans (s₂.trans (s₃.trans s₄))) (by ring)

/-- **One pass**: the rounds of fields `j`, `j + 1`, …, up to the last field `jl`. Their writes
join into one constant patch: with `n + j` equal to `N₀ + fieldOffset fs j` at field `j`, the
pass ends with `n'` cells, `n' + |fs|` equal to `N₀ + fieldOffset fs |fs|`, at the start of the
record's rewind.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of fields left, concatenating rounds; the last round's
next phase is the rewind. -/
private lemma cw_pass {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    {x : List Γ} (fs : List (List Γ)) (hfs : fs.length = m)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x) (hrec : RecordAt d 0 fs)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (N₀ r : ℕ)
    (hr : N₀ + fieldOffset fs fs.length + 1 ≤ r) (jl : Fin m) (hjl : jl.val + 1 = fs.length) :
    ∀ (i j : ℕ) (hj : j < fs.length), j + i + 1 = fs.length → ∀ n n' : ℕ,
      n + j = N₀ + fieldOffset fs j → n' + fs.length = N₀ + fieldOffset fs fs.length →
      ∃ t, t + 9 * fieldOffset fs j ≤ 9 * fieldOffset fs fs.length ∧
        Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
          (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
          (cw_cfg e d (⟨.copy p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ :
            Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) (fieldOffset fs j) n n)
          (cw_cfg e d (⟨.back p jl, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i)
            (fieldOffset fs fs.length) n' n') t := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj hji n n' hn hn'
    have hoff := fieldOffset_succ fs j hj
    have hj₁ : j + 1 = fs.length := by omega
    have hoffm : fieldOffset fs fs.length = fieldOffset fs (j + 1) := by rw [hj₁]
    have s := cw_round e R en ex p fs hfs d hrec hclk j hj n r (by omega) (by omega)
    have hjl' : jl = ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩ := Fin.ext (by show jl.val = j; omega)
    subst hjl'
    have hnext : (cw_next p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩ : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) =
        ⟨.back p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ := by
      unfold cw_next
      rw [dif_neg (show ¬(j + 1 < m) by omega)]
    rw [hnext, hj₁, show n + fs[j].length = n' by omega] at s
    exact ⟨_, by omega, s⟩
  | succ i ih =>
    intro j hj hji n n' hn hn'
    have hoff := fieldOffset_succ fs j hj
    have hle := fieldOffset_add_length_le fs (j + 1) (by omega)
    have hend := length_joinFields_add_one fs (List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (by omega))
    have hoff' := fieldOffset_succ fs (j + 1) (by omega)
    have s := cw_round e R en ex p fs hfs d hrec hclk j hj n r (by omega) (by omega)
    have hnext : (cw_next p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩ : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) =
        ⟨.copy p ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ := by
      unfold cw_next
      rw [dif_pos (show j + 1 < m by omega)]
    rw [hnext] at s
    obtain ⟨t, ht, s'⟩ := ih (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (n + fs[j].length) n' (by omega) hn'
    exact ⟨_, by omega, s.trans s'⟩

/-- **The skip back over a field on the record tape**, as a host segment: from the first cell
of the next field to the first cell of `f`, followed by the previous field's skip back, the next
pass, or the clock's rewind. -/
private lemma cw_seg_back {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    (j : Fin m) {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (f : List Γ) (a a' : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (r : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (f.length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + a' + z) = FinTM.bufferTape f z)
    (ha' : a' = a - f.length - 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a') (har : a ≤ r) (hbr : |b| ≤ r) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.back p j, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) a n b)
      (cw_cfg e d (cw_prev p j) a' n b) (f.length + 3 + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := skipBackTM_run_ofCfg 0 f (cw_cfg e d SeekPhase.run a n b) rfl
    fun z hz₁ hz₂ => by
      rw [cw_cfg_tape e d _ a n b 0 (cw_zero_ne_last K), cw_cfg_pos₀,
        show d.workTapePos 0 + a - f.length - 1 + z = d.workTapePos 0 + a' + z by omega]
      exact hf z hz₁ hz₂
  exact cw_seg_row e R en ex (.back p j) (by simp) d SeekPhase.run SeekPhase.done _
    (fun _ => rfl) a a' n b b _ r 0 _
    _ _ h₁ (cw_cfg_move₀ e d _ _ a n b _ a' (by rw [cw_cfg_pos₀]; omega)) h₂ h₃
    (by rw [cw_cfg_pos₀]; omega) (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]; exact har) hbr

/-- **The record's rewind**: the skips back over fields `j`, `j - 1`, …, `0`, from the first
cell after field `j` to the record's first cell, followed by the next pass or the clock's
rewind.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on `j`, concatenating the skips back; from the first cell of field `j +
1`, field `j` is the skip back's word. -/
private lemma cw_rewind {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    (hm : 0 < m) {x : List Γ} (fs : List (List Γ)) (hfs : fs.length = m)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x) (hrec : RecordAt d 0 fs)
    (n : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (r : ℕ) (hr : fieldOffset fs fs.length ≤ r) (hbr : |b| ≤ r) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < fs.length), ∃ t, t ≤ 4 * fieldOffset fs (j + 1) ∧
      Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
        (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
        (cw_cfg e d (⟨.back p ⟨j, hfs ▸ hj⟩, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ :
          Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) (fieldOffset fs (j + 1)) n b)
        (cw_cfg e d (cw_prev p (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m)) 0 n b) t := by
  have hend := length_joinFields_add_one fs (List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (by omega))
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro hj
    have hoff := fieldOffset_succ fs 0 hj
    have hle := fieldOffset_add_length_le fs 0 hj
    rw [fieldOffset_zero] at hoff hle
    have hfield := cw_field d 0 fs hrec 0 hj
    rw [fieldOffset_zero, Nat.cast_zero] at hfield
    refine ⟨_, ?_, cw_seg_back e R en ex p ⟨0, hfs ▸ hj⟩ d fs[0] _ 0 n b r hfield ?_ le_rfl
      ?_ hbr (by omega)⟩
    · omega
    · omega
    · omega
  | succ j ih =>
    intro hj
    have hoff := fieldOffset_succ fs (j + 1) hj
    have hle := fieldOffset_add_length_le fs (j + 1) hj
    have hfield := cw_field d 0 fs hrec (j + 1) hj
    have s := cw_seg_back e R en ex p ⟨j + 1, hfs ▸ hj⟩ d fs[j + 1]
      (fieldOffset fs (j + 1 + 1)) _ n b r hfield (by omega) (by positivity) (by omega) hbr
      (by omega)
    have hprev : (cw_prev p ⟨j + 1, hfs ▸ hj⟩ : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) =
        ⟨.back p ⟨j, by omega⟩, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ := by
      unfold cw_prev
      rw [if_pos (show 0 < j + 1 by omega)]
      rfl
    rw [hprev] at s
    obtain ⟨t, ht, s'⟩ := ih (by omega)
    exact ⟨_, by omega, s.trans s'⟩

/-- **One pass and the record's rewind**, from the record's first cell back to it. -/
private lemma cw_pass_rewind {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (p : Fin c)
    (hm : 0 < m) {x : List Γ} (fs : List (List Γ)) (hfs : fs.length = m)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x) (hrec : RecordAt d 0 fs)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (F N₀ N₁ r : ℕ)
    (hF : fieldOffset fs fs.length = F + fs.length) (hN₁ : N₁ = N₀ + F)
    (hr : N₀ + fieldOffset fs fs.length + 1 ≤ r) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ 13 * fieldOffset fs fs.length ∧
      Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
        (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
        (cw_cfg e d (⟨.copy p ⟨0, hm⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i)
          0 N₀ N₀)
        (cw_cfg e d (cw_prev p (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m)) 0 N₁ N₁) t := by
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, s₁⟩ := cw_pass e R en ex p fs hfs d hrec hclk N₀ r hr
    ⟨fs.length - 1, by omega⟩ (by show fs.length - 1 + 1 = fs.length; omega) (fs.length - 1) 0
    (by omega) (by omega)
    N₀ N₁ (by rw [fieldOffset_zero]) (by omega)
  rw [fieldOffset_zero, Nat.cast_zero] at s₁
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂, s₂⟩ := cw_rewind e R en ex p hm fs hfs d hrec N₁ N₁ r (by omega)
    (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; omega) (fs.length - 1) (by omega)
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ fs.length)] at s₂ ht₂
  exact ⟨_, by omega, s₁.trans s₂⟩

/-- **All passes**: from pass `p` on, each pass and the record's rewind; after the last pass the
clock holds `c · F` cells, `F` the record's field cells, and the clock's rewind follows.
**Proof sketch.** Induct on the number of passes left; after the first field's skip back the
next phase is the next pass or, after the last, the clock's rewind. -/
private lemma cw_passes {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {x : List Γ} (fs : List (List Γ)) (hfs : fs.length = m)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x) (hrec : RecordAt d 0 fs)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (F r : ℕ)
    (hF : fieldOffset fs fs.length = F + fs.length)
    (hr : c * fieldOffset fs fs.length + 1 ≤ r) :
    ∀ (i p : ℕ) (hp : p < c), p + i + 1 = c →
      ∃ t, t + 13 * p * fieldOffset fs fs.length ≤ 13 * c * fieldOffset fs fs.length ∧
        Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
          (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
          (cw_cfg e d (⟨.copy ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨0, hm⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ :
            Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) 0 (p * F) ((p * F : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (cw_cfg e d (⟨.skipC none, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) 0 (c * F)
            ((c * F : ℕ) : ℤ)) t := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro p hp hpi
    have hbound : p * F + fieldOffset fs fs.length + 1 ≤ r := by
      have : p * F + fieldOffset fs fs.length ≤ c * fieldOffset fs fs.length := by
        rw [← hpi, hF]
        ring_nf
        omega
      omega
    obtain ⟨t, ht, s⟩ := cw_pass_rewind e R en ex ⟨p, hp⟩ hm fs hfs d hrec hclk F (p * F)
      (c * F) r hF (by rw [← hpi]; ring) hbound
    have hprev : (cw_prev ⟨p, hp⟩ (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m) : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) =
        ⟨.skipC none, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ := by
      unfold cw_prev
      rw [if_neg (lt_irrefl 0), dif_neg (show ¬(p + 1 < c) by omega)]
    rw [hprev] at s
    refine ⟨t, ?_, s⟩
    rw [← hpi]
    nlinarith
  | succ i ih =>
    intro p hp hpi
    have hbound : p * F + fieldOffset fs fs.length + 1 ≤ r := by
      have : p * F + fieldOffset fs fs.length ≤ c * fieldOffset fs fs.length := by
        rw [← hpi, hF]
        ring_nf
        nlinarith
      omega
    obtain ⟨t, ht, s⟩ := cw_pass_rewind e R en ex ⟨p, hp⟩ hm fs hfs d hrec hclk F (p * F)
      ((p + 1) * F) r hF (by ring) hbound
    have hprev : (cw_prev ⟨p, hp⟩ (⟨0, hm⟩ : Fin m) : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) =
        ⟨.copy ⟨p + 1, by omega⟩ ⟨0, hm⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ := by
      unfold cw_prev
      rw [if_neg (lt_irrefl 0), dif_pos (show p + 1 < c by omega)]
    rw [hprev] at s
    obtain ⟨t', ht', s'⟩ := ih (p + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    refine ⟨t + t', ?_, s.trans s'⟩
    nlinarith

/-- **The skip back over the clock word**, as a host segment: from one cell past the clock's
right delimiter to the clock's first cell, followed by the windowed runner at its entry. -/
private lemma cw_seg_clockBack {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (W r : ℕ) (hWr : W + 1 ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.clockBack, (SeekPhase.run : SeekPhase)⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) 0 W
        ((W : ℤ) + 1))
      (cw_cfg e d (⟨.run, en⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) 0 W 0) (W + 3 + 1) := by
  let a₀ : Cfg (K + 2) Γ SeekPhase x := cw_cfg e d SeekPhase.run 0 W ((W : ℤ) + 1)
  have hu : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ ((List.replicate W e).length : ℤ) →
      a₀.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1))
          (a₀.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) - (List.replicate W e).length - 1 + z) =
        FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate W e) z := by
    intro z hz₁ hz₂
    have h := cw_skip_word e d hclk SeekPhase.run 0 W 0 W (by omega) z (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hz₁⟩) hz₂
    rw [cw_cfg_posL, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at h
    rw [cw_cfg_clockTape, cw_cfg_posL, List.length_replicate,
      show d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + ((W : ℤ) + 1) - W - 1 + z =
        d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + z by ring, ← h, cw_cfg_clockTape]
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := skipBackTM_run_ofCfg (Fin.last (K + 1)) _ a₀ rfl hu
  rw [List.length_replicate] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact cw_seg_row e R en ex (.clockBack : cw_Idx c m) (by simp) d SeekPhase.run SeekPhase.done
    _ (fun _ => rfl) 0 0 W ((W : ℤ) + 1)
    0 _ r _ _ _ _ h₁ (cw_cfg_moveL e d _ _ 0 W _ _ 0 (by rw [cw_cfg_posL]; omega)) h₂ h₃
    (by rw [cw_cfg_posL]; omega) (by simp) (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; omega)

/-- A run whose endpoint keeps the output has kept it at every earlier time. -/
private lemma cw_silence {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Γ S)
    (d : Cfg k Γ S x) (t : ℕ) (ht : (M.runFrom d t).output = d.output) :
    ∀ u ≤ t, (M.runFrom d u).output = d.output := by
  intro u hu
  have h₀ := MultiTapeTM.output_prefix M d (Nat.zero_le u)
  have h₁ := MultiTapeTM.output_prefix M d hu
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at h₀
  rw [ht] at h₁
  exact h₁.eq_of_length (le_antisymm h₁.length_le h₀.length_le)

/-- **The clock writer's contract.** From the record `fs` at the head of tape `0`, a blank clock
tape and the first copy's control, the host writes the all-`e` word of width `c · F` at the
clock head, `F` the record's field cells, returns both heads, and reaches the windowed runner's
entry. It is a segment avoiding the exits, within `r` cells of the start on every tape, and
silent.
**Proof sketch.** The passes, then the step past the clock's right delimiter and the skip back
over the clock word. -/
private lemma cw_writer {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hm : 0 < m) {x : List Γ} (fs : List (List Γ)) (hfs : fs.length = m)
    (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (hd : d.state = some ⟨.copy ⟨0, hc⟩ ⟨0, hm⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩)
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 fs) (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (r : ℕ)
    (hr : c * fieldOffset fs fs.length + 2 ≤ r) :
    ∃ t ≤ 13 * c * fieldOffset fs fs.length + c * (fs.map List.length).sum + 6,
      Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
        (cw_box d.workTapePos r) d
        (cw_cfg e d (⟨.run, en⟩ : Σ i, cw_Ctrl P i) 0 (c * (fs.map List.length).sum) 0) t ∧
      ∀ u ≤ t, ((cw_hostTM e R en ex c m).runFrom d u).output = d.output := by
  have hne : fs ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (by omega)
  have hF : fieldOffset fs fs.length = (fs.map List.length).sum + fs.length := by
    have h₁ := joinFields_length fs hne
    have h₂ := length_joinFields_add_one fs hne
    have h₃ : 1 ≤ fs.length := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hne
    omega
  have hcm : c * (fs.map List.length).sum ≤ c * fieldOffset fs fs.length :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, s₁⟩ := cw_passes e R en ex hm fs hfs d hrec hclk
    (fs.map List.length).sum r hF (by omega) (c - 1) 0 hc (by omega)
  rw [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.cast_zero, cw_cfg_zero e d _ hd] at s₁
  have s₂ := cw_seg_skipC e R en ex none d hclk 0 (c * (fs.map List.length).sum)
    (c * (fs.map List.length).sum) 0 rfl ((c * (fs.map List.length).sum : ℕ) + 1) (by ring) r
    (by simp) (by omega)
  have s₃ := cw_seg_clockBack e R en ex d hclk (c * (fs.map List.length).sum) r (by omega)
  have s := s₁.trans (s₂.trans s₃)
  refine ⟨_, by omega, s, cw_silence _ d _ ?_⟩
  rw [((segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).1 s).1]
  rfl


/-- **The windowed runner**, as a host segment from its entry to its exit `y`, dispatched to
the clear or the exits. -/
private lemma cw_seg_run {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} {x : List Γ}
    (a : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x) (t : ℕ) (y : WindowExit) (q : Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i)
    (hst : (R.runFrom a t).state = some (ex y))
    (hcut : ∀ u < t, ∀ y', (R.runFrom a u).state ≠ some (ex y'))
    (hred : cw_red en ex .run (ex y) = some q) (B : (Fin (K + 2) → ℤ) → Prop)
    (hB : ∀ u ≤ t, B (R.runFrom a u).workTapePos) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩} B
      (a.mapState (Sigma.mk (cw_Idx.run : cw_Idx c m))) ((R.runFrom a t).mapState fun _ => q)
      (t + 1) :=
  cw_seg e R en ex (.run : cw_Idx c m) (by simp) a _ t rfl (ex y) hst q hred
    (fun u hu z hz => by
      have hne : ∀ y', z ≠ ex y' := fun y' h => hcut u hu y' (hz.trans (congrArg some h))
      rw [cw_red, if_neg (hne _), if_neg (hne _), if_neg (hne _)])
    B hB

/-- **The clear after the runner**, as a host segment. The runner's `halted` or `left`
endpoint, whose clock tape is the word `w` patched over the writer's clock word, is cleared
back to a blank clock, and the host stops with that exit; the record tape keeps the runner's
record `g`.
**Proof sketch.** The clock is blank outside `w`'s interval, since the writer's word has
`w`'s width; the clear of a patch then blanks the whole clock tape. -/
private lemma cw_seg_clear {K : ℕ} {Γ P : Type} [DecidableEq P] (e : Γ)
    (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 2) Γ P) (en : P) (ex : WindowExit → P) {c m : ℕ} (b : Bool)
    {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg (K + 2) Γ (Σ i : cw_Idx c m, cw_Ctrl P i) x)
    (hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none) (W : ℕ) (w : List Γ)
    (hw : w.length = W) (L : ℤ) (g : ℤ → Option Γ) (y : P) (r : ℕ) (hr : W + 1 ≤ r) :
    Segment (cw_hostTM e R en ex c m) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
      (cw_box d.workTapePos r)
      (({ cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0 with
          state := some y
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = 0 ∧ (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapePos 0 ≤ q ∧
                q < (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapePos 0 + L
              then g (q - (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapePos 0)
            else if j = Fin.last (K + 1) then
              wordPatch ((cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapes j)
                ((cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapePos j) w q
            else (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapes j q } : Cfg (K + 2) Γ P x).mapState
        fun _ => ⟨.clear b, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩)
      ({ d with
          state := some ⟨.stop, (if b then .halted else .left : WindowExit)⟩
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos 0 ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos 0 + L
              then g (q - d.workTapePos 0) else d.workTapes j q })
      (2 * w.length + 2 + 1) := by
  have hpos := cw_cfg_pos_zero e d en W
  have hlast : (Fin.last (K + 1) : Fin (K + 2)) ≠ 0 := (cw_zero_ne_last K).symm
  let d₀ : Cfg (K + 2) Γ SweepPhase x :=
    ⟨some .sweep, d.inputPos,
      fun j q => if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos 0 ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos 0 + L
        then g (q - d.workTapePos 0) else (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapes j q,
      d.workTapePos, d.output⟩
  have hL₀ : d₀.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) = (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapes
      (Fin.last (K + 1)) := by
    funext q
    show (if (Fin.last (K + 1) : Fin (K + 2)) = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos 0 ≤ q ∧
        q < d.workTapePos 0 + L then g (q - d.workTapePos 0)
      else (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0).workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) q) = _
    rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_left _ hlast)]
  have hb : ∀ q, q < d₀.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) ∨
      d₀.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + (w.length : ℤ) ≤ q →
      d₀.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) q = none := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : q < d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) ∨
        d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + (W : ℤ) ≤ q := by
      rw [← hw]
      exact hq
    rw [hL₀, cw_cfg_clock, if_neg (by omega), hclk]
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := cw_clear_patch (Fin.last (K + 1)) w d₀ hb
  have hseg := cw_seg e R en ex (.clear b : cw_Idx c m) (by simp) _ _ _ h₁ SweepPhase.done rfl
    ⟨.stop, (if b then .halted else .left : WindowExit)⟩ (by rw [cw_red, if_pos rfl])
    (cw_guard e R en ex (.clear b : cw_Idx c m) _ _ _ h₂ fun z hz => by rw [cw_red, if_neg hz])
    (cw_box d.workTapePos r) (fun u hu => cw_box_row _ _ _ _ _ r _ (fun j => h₃ j u hu)
      (by
        show d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) - r ≤ d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) - 1 ∧
          d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + (w.length : ℤ) ≤ d.workTapePos (Fin.last (K + 1)) + r
        omega) fun j => by
        change |d.workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ (r : ℤ)
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
        positivity)
  convert hseg using 1
  · refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, Cfg.mapState_state]
      rfl
    · rw [(cw_mapState_io _ _).1, (cw_mapState_io _ _).1]
      rfl
    · funext j q
      rw [cw_mapState_tapes, cw_mapState_tapes]
      change (if j = 0 ∧ _ then _ else _) = (if j = Fin.last (K + 1) then _ else _)
      rw [cw_cfg_pos₀, add_zero]
      by_cases hj : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
      · subst hj
        rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_left _ hlast), if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl, hL₀, cw_cfg_posL,
          add_zero]
      · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj]
    · rw [cw_mapState_pos, cw_mapState_pos]
      exact hpos
    · rw [(cw_mapState_io _ _).2, (cw_mapState_io _ _).2]
      rfl
  · refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_state]
      rfl
    · rw [(cw_mapState_io _ _).1]
    · funext j q
      rw [cw_mapState_tapes]
      change (if j = 0 ∧ _ then _ else _) =
        (if j = Fin.last (K + 1) then none else d₀.workTapes j q)
      by_cases hj : j = Fin.last (K + 1)
      · subst hj
        rw [if_neg (not_and_of_not_left _ hlast), if_pos rfl, hclk]
      · rw [if_neg hj]
        change _ = (if j = 0 ∧ _ then _ else _)
        rw [cw_cfg_tape e d en 0 W 0 j hj]
    · rw [cw_mapState_pos]
    · rw [(cw_mapState_io _ _).2]

/-- The target's run-time clauses from a host segment that ends in an exit: no exit earlier,
the head bound, silence and the space bound. -/
private lemma cw_finish {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (H : MultiTapeTM k Γ S)
    (F : Set (Option S)) (d b : Cfg k Γ S x) (t r : ℕ)
    (hseg : Segment H F (cw_box d.workTapePos r) d b t) (hout : b.output = d.output) :
    (∀ u < t, (H.runFrom d u).state ∉ F) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(H.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ (r : ℤ)) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ t, (H.runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧ H.spaceUsed d t ≤ k * (2 * r + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).1 hseg
  exact ⟨h₂, h₃, cw_silence H d t (by rw [h₁, hout]),
    MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_le_of_abs_le H d t r h₃⟩

/-- **H3 with the configuration-count clock** (what `Complexity.space_hierarchy`'s
diagonalizer cites). The windowed runner that builds its own clock. For a fixed binary machine
`M` and a tag update `upd` that ignores silent steps, there is a module over the record alphabet
with an entry and three distinct exits `exit e`, as follows. Start it at its entry with the
record of a windowed configuration `c` with tag `τ` at the head of tape `0`, every other tape
blank, and the native input `x` as digits. Then it reaches an exit `exit out` within
`C · 2^(C·(L + 1))` steps, where `L` is the record length, and no exit earlier. Up to then
every head stays within `C · (L + 1)` cells of its entry position, so the space used is `O(L)`
with constants depending only on `M` and `upd`, and the output is unchanged. Moreover:
* **the configuration count suffices**: if `N ≤ configBound M |x| s + 1` rounds of
  `Turing.windowRun` stop, then `out` is their exit, and the stopping record is on tape `0`;
* if `out` is `halted` or `left`, it is the exit of a stopping `Turing.windowRun`, whose record
  is on tape `0`, with every other tape blank again and every head and the input position
  restored.

With `Turing.windowRun_summary_of_halts`, a halting run of `M` within `s` cells and
`configBound M |x| s` steps is reported as `halted` with its output's tag. The bound
`N ≤ configBound + 1` contains the extra halt-test round (the RD-3 gate's check 4). [AB09,
§4.1.3, Theorem 4.8 with Exercise 4.1; §4.1.1, Claim 4.4; the construction is the repository's
refinement]

**Proof sketch.** The statement does not fix the clock, and two routes meet it.

*Route A (one shared clock).* Build the clock word, then run `Turing.exists_windowRunnerTM` on
it, then clear it. The clock word is all `true` of width `W := c_M · L`: by
`Turing.FinTM.configBound_le_two_pow`, the configuration count is at most
`2 ^ (|Q| + posWidth |x| + 3k(2s + 1))`, the per-round cost is
`C · (L + |x| + 1) ≤ C · 2^(L + 1)` (since `|x| + 2 ≤ 2^(posWidth |x|)` and
`posWidth |x| ≤ L`), and `L ≥ k(2s + 1) + posWidth |x|`; so `2^W - 1` exceeds
`C · (configBound + 1) · (L + |x| + 1)` for a constant `c_M` depending only on `|Q|` and `C`
(`L ≥ 4`). The word is written by copying the record's layout `c_M` times onto a scratch tape
and mapping every cell to `digit true` (`Turing.copyTM`, `Turing.skipTM`, `Turing.scanTM`, as
S1b's plan does, design §12.8a §4 step 5); it costs `O(L)` cells and time. After a `halted` or
`left` exit, clear the clock (`Turing.clearTM_run_ofCfg`) and rewind its head.

*Route B (the round clock, proved today; the RD-3 gate's minor 3).* Run the window round (the
test row, then the step row) as the body of `Turing.counterLoopTMVia`, with the anchor at the
round's start and the halt and window exits merged into its one optional early exit
(`Turing.counterLoopTMVia_run_escape`), clock exhaustion being `done`
(`Turing.counterLoopTMVia_run_done`); after an escape, one more test row tells `halted` from
`left` on the unchanged record. The clock word has width `|Q| + posWidth |x| + 3k(2s + 1) + 1`
or more, so its value exceeds `configBound M |x| s`: rounds, not steps, are counted, and the
time is at most the clock value times `C · (L + |x| + 1)` (`Turing.counterLoop_time_le`).

**Implementation status.** Proved, by Route A with the clock over field cells. The record's
fields are separated by blank cells and a mapped copy reads one blank-delimited word, so the
all-true clock word has width `W = c · F ≤ c · L`, where `F` counts the field cells, and it is
written field by field: in each of `c = C + |Q| + 8` passes (`C` the windowed runner's
constant), each field is copied onto the clock through the constant map, the two heads skip past
it and the clock head steps back onto the clock's delimiter; after each pass the record head
skips back over the fields, and after the last the clock head returns to the clock's first cell.
The word's value suffices for every round up to `configBound + 1` (`cw_record_clock`). One phase
host (`cw_hostTM`) runs the writer, `Turing.exists_windowRunnerTM` on the word, the clear of the
clock after a `halted` or `left` exit, and the exits. The writer and the clear take `O(L)` steps
and cells and the runner at most `5 · (2^W - 1) + 2W + 3` steps (`cw_time_bound`); the head
bound adds the runner's (`cw_head_bound`), silence follows from the endpoint, and the space
bound from the head bound. The construction over the whole layout sketched above
(`W := c_M · L`) is not used.
 -/
theorem exists_configWindowRunnerTM (M : FinTM Bool) {T : Type} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
    (upd : T → Option Bool → T) (hupd : ∀ τ, upd τ none = τ) :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (P : Type) (_ : Fintype P) (_ : DecidableEq P)
      (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) (RecSym M.State T) P) (entry : P) (exit : WindowExit → P)
      (C : ℕ),
      (∀ e, exit e ≠ entry) ∧ Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (τ : T), c.InWindow s →
      ∀ d : Cfg (K + 1) (RecSym M.State T) P (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb M.State T)),
        d.state = some entry → RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ) →
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 1), j ≠ 0 → ∀ p, d.workTapes j p = none) →
        ∃ (t : ℕ) (out : WindowExit),
          t ≤ C * 2 ^ (C * (recordLength M.k x.length s + 1)) ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).state = some (exit out) ∧
          (∀ u < t, ∀ e, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (exit e)) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin (K + 1), |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
            ((C * (recordLength M.k x.length s + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, (R.runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧
          R.spaceUsed d t ≤ (K + 1) * (2 * C * (recordLength M.k x.length s + 1) + 1) ∧
          (∀ N ≤ M.configBound x.length s + 1, (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).1 ≠ .exhausted →
            out = (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).1) ∧
          (out ≠ .exhausted → ∃ N, (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).1 = out ∧
            R.runFrom d t =
              { d with
                state := some (exit out)
                workTapes := fun j q =>
                  if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos 0 ≤ q ∧
                      q < d.workTapePos 0 + (recordLength M.k x.length s : ℤ)
                    then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).2.1
                      (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).2.2) (q - d.workTapePos 0)
                  else d.workTapes j q }) := by
  obtain ⟨K, P, hP, dP, R₂, en, ex, C₂, -, hinj, hrun⟩ := exists_windowRunnerTM M upd hupd
  letI := hP
  letI := dP
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, e = RecSym.digitEmb M.State T true := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨nc, hnc⟩ : ∃ nc, nc = C₂ + Fintype.card M.State + 8 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A, A = 14 * nc + 13 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, C = A + 4 * nc + 0 + 10 + C₂ * (nc + 1) + nc + 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hnc₀ : 0 < nc := by omega
  have hm₀ : 0 < M.k + 3 := by omega
  have hexne : ∀ y y' : WindowExit, y ≠ y' → ex y ≠ ex y' := fun y y' h h' => h (hinj h')
  refine ⟨K + 1, Σ i : cw_Idx nc (M.k + 3), cw_Ctrl P i, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    cw_hostTM e R₂ en ex nc (M.k + 3), ⟨.copy ⟨0, hnc₀⟩ ⟨0, hm₀⟩, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩,
    fun y => ⟨.stop, y⟩, C, fun y h => absurd (congrArg Sigma.fst h) (by simp),
    fun y y' h => eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2, ?_⟩
  intro x s c τ hwin d hd hrec hblank
  -- the record: its fields, its length and its last offset
  have hfs : (cfgRecord s c τ).length = M.k + 3 := cfgRecord_length s c τ
  have hne : cfgRecord s c τ ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (by omega)
  have hoff : fieldOffset (cfgRecord s c τ) (cfgRecord s c τ).length =
      recordLength M.k x.length s + 1 := by
    rw [← length_joinFields_add_one _ hne, joinFields_cfgRecord_length]
  -- the clock: `nc` passes over the field cells
  obtain ⟨hWL, hclock⟩ := cw_record_clock M s c τ C₂
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W, W = nc * ((cfgRecord s c τ).map List.length).sum := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hnc, ← hW] at hWL hclock
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L, L = recordLength M.k x.length s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL] at hWL hoff
  have hclk : ∀ z, d.workTapes (Fin.last (K + 1)) z = none :=
    hblank _ (cw_zero_ne_last K).symm
  have hCnc : nc + 2 ≤ C := by omega
  have hCr : C₂ * (nc + 1) ≤ C := by omega
  have hCL : (nc + 2) * (L + 1) ≤ C * (L + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (L + 1) hCnc
  have hCL' : (nc + 2) * (L + 1) = nc * (L + 1) + 2 * L + 2 := by ring
  have hncL : nc * L ≤ nc * (L + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left nc (by omega)
  have hWr : W + 1 ≤ C * (L + 1) := by omega
  -- the writer
  obtain ⟨Tw, hTw, sw, -⟩ := cw_writer e R₂ en ex hnc₀ hm₀ (cfgRecord s c τ) hfs d hd hrec hclk
    (C * (L + 1)) (by rw [hoff]; omega)
  rw [hoff, ← hW] at hTw
  rw [← hW] at sw
  -- the windowed runner on the clock word
  obtain ⟨t₂, out, ht₂, hst, hcut, henv, hsil, -, hcert, hfin⟩ :=
    hrun s c τ hwin (List.replicate W true) (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0) rfl
      ((recordAt_iff _ _ _).2 fun p hp₁ hp₂ => by
        rw [cw_cfg_tape e d en 0 W 0 0 (cw_zero_ne_last K), cw_cfg_pos₀, add_zero]
        exact (recordAt_iff _ _ _).1 hrec p hp₁ hp₂)
      (fun p hp₁ hp₂ => by
        rw [List.map_replicate, ← he]
        exact cw_skip_word e d hclk en 0 W 0 W (by omega) p (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hp₁⟩)
          (by rwa [List.length_replicate] at hp₂ ⊢))
      (fun j h₀ hL p => by
        rw [cw_cfg_tape e d en 0 W 0 j hL]
        exact hblank j h₀ p)
  rw [List.length_replicate] at ht₂ henv
  rw [cw_true_value] at ht₂
  have hB : ∀ u ≤ t₂, cw_box d.workTapePos (C * (L + 1))
      (R₂.runFrom (cw_cfg e d en 0 W 0) u).workTapePos := by
    intro u hu j
    have h := henv u hu j
    rw [cw_cfg_pos_zero, ← hL] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    have h₁ := cw_head_bound C₂ hWL
    have h₂ : C₂ * (nc + 1) * (L + 1) ≤ C * (L + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (L + 1) hCr
    exact_mod_cast h₁.trans h₂
  -- the three exits
  have key : ∃ (t : ℕ) (b : Cfg (K + 2) (RecSym M.State T) (Σ i : cw_Idx nc (M.k + 3), cw_Ctrl P i)
      (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb M.State T))), t ≤ Tw + (t₂ + 1) + (2 * W + 3) ∧
      Segment (cw_hostTM e R₂ en ex nc (M.k + 3)) {z | ∃ y : WindowExit, z = some ⟨.stop, y⟩}
        (cw_box d.workTapePos (C * (L + 1))) d b t ∧
      b.state = some ⟨.stop, out⟩ ∧ b.output = d.output ∧
      (out ≠ .exhausted → ∃ N, (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).1 = out ∧
        b = { d with
          state := some ⟨.stop, out⟩
          workTapes := fun j q =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos 0 ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos 0 + (L : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).2.1
                (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).2.2) (q - d.workTapePos 0)
            else d.workTapes j q }) := by
    by_cases hex : out = .exhausted
    · subst hex
      have hred : cw_red en ex (.run : cw_Idx nc (M.k + 3)) (ex .exhausted) =
          some ⟨.stop, (WindowExit.exhausted : WindowExit)⟩ := by
        rw [cw_red, if_neg (hexne _ _ (by simp)), if_neg (hexne _ _ (by simp)), if_pos rfl]
      have sr := cw_seg_run e R₂ en ex (c := nc) (m := M.k + 3) _ t₂ .exhausted _ hst hcut hred
        _ hB
      rw [cw_cfg_mapState] at sr
      refine ⟨_, _, by omega, sw.trans sr, ?_, ?_, fun h => absurd rfl h⟩
      · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, hst]
        rfl
      · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, hsil t₂ le_rfl]
        rfl
    · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b : Bool, out = if b then .halted else .left := by
        cases out
        · exact ⟨true, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨false, rfl⟩
        · exact absurd rfl hex
      obtain ⟨N, hN, w', hw', hend⟩ := hfin hex
      have hred : cw_red en ex (.run : cw_Idx nc (M.k + 3)) (ex (if b then .halted else .left)) =
          some ⟨.clear b, (SweepPhase.sweep : SweepPhase)⟩ := by
        cases b
        · show cw_red en ex (.run : cw_Idx nc (M.k + 3)) (ex .left) = _
          rw [cw_red, if_neg (hexne _ _ (by simp)), if_pos rfl]
        · show cw_red en ex (.run : cw_Idx nc (M.k + 3)) (ex .halted) = _
          rw [cw_red, if_pos rfl]
      have sr := cw_seg_run e R₂ en ex (c := nc) (m := M.k + 3) _ t₂ _ _ hst hcut hred _ hB
      rw [cw_cfg_mapState, hend, ← hL] at sr
      have hw : (w'.map (RecSym.digitEmb M.State T)).length = W := by
        rw [List.length_map, hw', List.length_replicate]
      have sc := cw_seg_clear e R₂ en ex b d hclk W _ hw (L : ℤ)
        (fieldsTape (cfgRecord s (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).2.1
          (windowRun M.tm s upd N c τ).2.2)) (ex (if b then .halted else .left)) (C * (L + 1))
        hWr
      refine ⟨_, _, ?_, sw.trans (sr.trans sc), rfl, rfl, fun _ => ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩⟩
      rw [hw]
      omega
  obtain ⟨t, b, ht, hseg, hbst, hbout, hbfin⟩ := key
  obtain ⟨hF, hE, hS, hSp⟩ := cw_finish _ _ d b t (C * (L + 1)) hseg hbout
  have hrunb := ((segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).1 hseg).1
  refine ⟨t, out, ?_, by rw [hrunb, hbst], fun u hu y h => hF u hu ⟨y, h⟩, ?_, hS, ?_,
    fun N hN hNe => hcert N hNe (hclock N hN), fun hex => ?_⟩
  · -- the time bound
    have h₁ := cw_time_bound (c := nc) A 0 hWL
    have h₂ : A * (L + 1) = 14 * (nc * (L + 1)) + 13 * (L + 1) := by
      rw [hA]
      ring
    have h₄ : A + 4 * nc + 0 + 10 ≤ C := by omega
    have h₅ : (A + 4 * nc + 0 + 10) * 2 ^ ((A + 4 * nc + 0 + 10) * (L + 1)) ≤
        C * 2 ^ (C * (L + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul h₄ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (L + 1) h₄))
    have h₆ : 13 * nc * (L + 1) = 13 * (nc * (L + 1)) := by ring
    rw [← hL]
    omega
  · -- the head bound
    intro u hu j
    rw [← hL]
    exact hE u hu j
  · -- the space bound
    rw [← hL, mul_assoc 2 C]
    exact hSp
  · obtain ⟨N, hN, hb⟩ := hbfin hex
    refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
    rw [hrunb, hb, ← hL]

end Turing
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CfgRecord.lean =====

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bits
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Catalog
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.SymbolLift
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputCall
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Contract
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.CfgFacts

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Machine-construction library: configuration records over a rich alphabet (§12.8)

The record carrier of the §12.8 rich-alphabet design
(`machine-library-design.md` §12.8a §2, decision 12.8.1): a configuration of a
`Bool` machine with work tapes inside a radius-`s` window, written as a list of
fields over the rich alphabet `Turing.RecSym`. Records are what the
configuration-graph searches of chapter 4 (the reachability simulation of
`NSPACE` in `DSPACE` by breadth-first search, Savitch's midpoint recursion)
keep on their tapes, and the record rows are the machines that read, step and
compare them.

**Status.** Everything here is proved: the pure decoding facts and all three record rows.
The rows compose the framed catalog and counter rows through their contracts
(`Turing.Contract.segment` and each row's field equations) inside one phase host, and
join the phases by `Turing.Segment.trans`. No public result or private helper in this
module is admitted.

## Design

* **One cell per simulated cell.** A tape field holds the `2s + 1` window cells
  of one work tape, each a content track and a head-mark track
  (`Turing.RecSym.cell`). The input position is a fixed-width binary field of
  digits, `O(log n)` cells, and the state and the tag take one cell each. A
  record therefore has `k(2s + 1) + posWidth n + 2` cells and `k + 2`
  separators, which is `O(S n)` at radius `O(S n)` for `S ≥ log`.
* **Blank-separated fields** (`Turing.joinFields`): every field is a §12.6
  delimited word in place (`Turing.fieldsTape_field`), so the framed catalog
  rows apply field by field, and no field is empty, so two blanks end a table.
* **Digits are the lift's `e`.** `Turing.RecSym.digitEmb` is the embedding
  along which the `Bool` counter rows run on rich tapes
  (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols`), and the native input of a rich
  simulator is the input's image under it.
* **The window predicate** `Turing.Cfg.InWindow` lives here, relocated
  verbatim from `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBF` (decision 12.8.2), which
  now imports it, so the record carrier and the adjacency codec share one
  definition.
* **Record rows are existential modules** in the `exists_installCallTM` style:
  a machine, entry and verdict anchors, and a linear first-return bound, with
  every head, the input position and the scratch restored.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.Cfg.InWindow` — the radius-`s` window predicate (relocated).
* `Turing.RecSym`, `Turing.RecSym.digitEmb` — the record alphabet and its
  digit embedding.
* `Turing.binDigits`, `Turing.posWidth` — fixed-width binary digits and the
  input-position width.
* `Turing.cfgRecord` — the record of a configuration.
* `Turing.RecordValid`, `Turing.RecordAt` — valid records, and a record laid
  out at a head.

## Main results

* `Turing.cfgRecord_length` — a record has `k + 3` fields.
* `Turing.Cfg.inWindow_init` — the initial configuration is in every window.
* `Turing.Cfg.InWindow.mono`, `Turing.Cfg.InWindow.apply_iff` — windows grow with the
  radius; one action keeps a window configuration in its window exactly when no head
  crosses a boundary.
* `Turing.Cfg.InWindow.apply_of_lt` — a step from a window configuration whose heads are
  strictly inside a radius stays in that radius's window.
* `Turing.cfgRecord_inj` — on windowed configurations, records agree exactly
  when configuration cores and tags do (proved; fill-C status update).
* `Turing.recordValid_iff` — validity as a field-by-field shape condition
  (proved; fill-C status update).
* `Turing.exists_recordStepTM`, `Turing.exists_recordEqTM`,
  `Turing.exists_recordTestTM` — the record rows R8.7: one simulated step, record
  equality, and a test of the state and tag (fill-C continuation 3 status update:
  all three are proved).
* `Turing.recordAt_iff`, `Turing.record_pos_lt` — reading a record and the position-width
  bound, the specification API (user, 2026-10-16).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1: the configuration graph and
  Claim 4.4(1), the `O(S(n))`-bit description of a configuration;
  Theorem 4.2(iii) and Theorem 4.14 (Savitch), whose simulations search the
  graph keeping configuration descriptions on work tapes. The record adds an
  `O(log n)` input-position field, as the book's description does.)
-/

namespace Turing

/-! ### The window predicate -/

/-- A configuration lies **in the radius-`s` window** when every work head
sits within `[-s, s]` and every work cell outside `[-s, s]` is blank — the
side condition under which the packaged codec of
`Complexity.exists_adjacency_codec_cnf` is faithful. (The input head needs no
clause: its type bounds it.) It is equally the side condition under which a
configuration record determines its configuration core, together with its
separately supplied tag (`Turing.cfgRecord_inj`);
relocated here from `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBF` (decision 12.8.2). -/
def Cfg.InWindow {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} (s : ℕ)
    (c : Cfg k Symbol State x) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, |c.workTapePos i| ≤ (s : ℤ)) ∧
  ∀ (i : Fin k) (z : ℤ), (s : ℤ) < |z| → c.workTapes i z = none

/-- **Windows grow with the radius**: a configuration in the radius-`s` window is in the
radius-`s'` window whenever `s ≤ s'`. -/
theorem Cfg.InWindow.mono {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} {s s' : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg k Symbol State x} (hc : c.InWindow s) (hs : s ≤ s') : c.InWindow s' :=
  ⟨fun i => (hc.1 i).trans (by exact_mod_cast hs),
    fun i z hz => hc.2 i z (lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hs) hz)⟩

/-- **One step from a window**: if `c` lies in the radius-`s` window, then applying an action `a`
keeps it there exactly when, for every work tape `i`, the head is not at `-s` with `a` moving it
left, and not at `s` with `a` moving it right. The write lands under the old head, which is inside
the window, so it cannot create a nonblank cell outside.

**Proof sketch.** Split the three possible moves. Interior positions stay inside; at each
boundary only its outward move fails. Outside cells are unchanged by the point update. -/
theorem Cfg.InWindow.apply_iff {k : ℕ} {Symbol State : Type} {x : List Symbol} {s : ℕ}
    {c : Cfg k Symbol State x} (hc : c.InWindow s) (a : Action k Symbol State) :
    (a.apply c).InWindow s ↔ ∀ i,
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = -(s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = -1) ∧
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = (s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = 1) := by
  have heads (i : Fin k) : |c.workTapePos i + ((a.workTapes i).2 : ℤ)| ≤ (s : ℤ) ↔
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = -(s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = -1) ∧
      ¬ (c.workTapePos i = (s : ℤ) ∧ (a.workTapes i).2 = 1) := by
    have h := hc.1 i
    rw [abs_le] at h ⊢
    cases hm : (a.workTapes i).2 <;>
      simp only [SignType.zero_eq_zero, SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, SignType.pos_eq_one,
        SignType.coe_zero, SignType.coe_neg, SignType.coe_one, Int.reduceNeg, add_zero,
        le_add_neg_iff_add_le, neg_add_le_iff_le_add, add_neg_le_iff_le_add,
        SignType.neg_eq_self_iff, SignType.self_eq_neg_iff, reduceCtorEq, zero_ne_one, one_ne_zero,
        and_false, and_true, true_and, and_self, not_false_eq_true, iff_true] at * <;>
      omega
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hi := h.1 i
    rw [Action.apply_workTapePos] at hi
    exact (heads i).mp hi
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Action.apply_workTapePos]
      exact (heads i).mpr (h i)
    intro i z hz
    have hne : z ≠ c.workTapePos i := by
      intro he
      subst z
      have := hc.1 i
      omega
    rw [Action.apply_workTapes, Function.update_of_ne hne]
    exact hc.2 i z hz

/-! ### The record alphabet -/

/-- **The record alphabet** (design §12.8a §2) over machine states `Q` and tags
`T`: binary digits, simulated work cells with a head-mark track, the state
cell, and the tag cell. Fields of a record are separated by blank cells. -/
inductive RecSym (Q T : Type) where
  /-- a binary digit: the input-position field, counters, and the native input -/
  | digit (b : Bool)
  /-- one simulated work cell: its content and whether the head is on it -/
  | cell (content : Option Bool) (mark : Bool)
  /-- the state cell, `none` for halted -/
  | st (q : Option Q)
  /-- the tag cell: a summary of what the run has emitted -/
  | tag (τ : T)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- The record alphabet is finite when the states and tags are; this is the
`Fintype` instance `Turing.FinTM.alphabet_reduction` needs. -/
instance recSymFintype (Q T : Type) [Fintype Q] [Fintype T] : Fintype (RecSym Q T) :=
  derive_fintype% _

/-- **The digit embedding** (design §12.8a §2): `Bool` into the record alphabet
by `Turing.RecSym.digit`. It is the `e` along which `Bool` rows and the `Bool`
input are lifted to rich tapes (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.liftSymbols`). -/
def RecSym.digitEmb (Q T : Type) : Bool ↪ RecSym Q T :=
  ⟨RecSym.digit, fun _ _ h => by cases h; rfl⟩

/-- The digit embedding sends a bit to its digit symbol: `RecSym.digitEmb Q T b = RecSym.digit b`
(the specification API, the briefs' pre-ship inventories, 2026-10-16). -/
theorem RecSym.digitEmb_apply (Q T : Type) (b : Bool) : RecSym.digitEmb Q T b = RecSym.digit b :=
  rfl

/-! ### The record -/

/-- **Fixed-width binary digits** (design §12.8a §2): the `w` low bits of `v`,
least significant first. -/
def binDigits (w v : ℕ) : List Bool := (List.range w).map v.testBit

/-- The `w` low bits of `v`, least significant first: `binDigits w v = (range w).map v.testBit` (the
specification API, the briefs' pre-ship inventories, 2026-10-16). -/
theorem binDigits_eq (w v : ℕ) : binDigits w v = (List.range w).map v.testBit :=
  rfl

/-- **The input-position width** (design §12.8a §2) at input length `n`: the
bit length of `n + 1`, so that `2 ^ posWidth n > n + 1` and every input
position `0, …, n + 1` has a distinct `Turing.binDigits` code. -/
def posWidth (n : ℕ) : ℕ := (Nat.bits (n + 1)).length

/-- The input-position width is the bit length of `n + 1`: `posWidth n = (Nat.bits (n + 1)).length`
(the specification API, the briefs' pre-ship inventories, 2026-10-16). -/
theorem posWidth_eq (n : ℕ) : posWidth n = (Nat.bits (n + 1)).length :=
  rfl

/-- **The configuration record** (design §12.8a §2) of `c` at window radius
`s` with tag `τ`: `k + 3` fields. Field `0` is the state, field `1` the input
position in `Turing.binDigits` of width `Turing.posWidth |x|`, fields `2` to
`k + 1` the window cells `-s, …, s` of each work tape with their head marks,
and field `k + 2` the tag. The output tape is not recorded; the tag summarizes
it. -/
def cfgRecord {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) :
    List (List (RecSym Q T)) :=
  [RecSym.st c.state] ::
    ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map RecSym.digit) ::
    (((List.finRange k).map fun i => (List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun j =>
      RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((j : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (j : ℤ) - s))) ++
    [[RecSym.tag τ]])

/-- **Record length** (design §12.8a §2): a record has `k + 3` fields, whatever
the configuration, radius and tag. -/
theorem cfgRecord_length {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x)
    (τ : T) : (cfgRecord s c τ).length = k + 3 := by
  simp [cfgRecord]

/-- Every native input position is strictly below the power of two specified by its width:
`n + 2 ≤ 2 ^ posWidth n`. (Public since the specification API, user 2026-10-16.)

**Proof sketch.** `posWidth n` is the bit length of `n + 1`, which is its `Nat.size`. -/
theorem record_pos_lt (n : ℕ) : n + 1 < 2 ^ posWidth n := by
  unfold posWidth
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  exact Nat.lt_size_self _

/-- Decoding the fixed-width digits recovers any value below the width's power of two.

**Proof sketch.** Remove the low bit and divide the value by two. The induction hypothesis
decodes the remaining bits; the quotient-remainder identity restores the original value. -/
private theorem record_digits_value (w v : ℕ) (hv : v < 2 ^ w) :
    Nat.ofDigits 2 ((binDigits w v).map Bool.toNat) = v := by
  induction w generalizing v with
  | zero => simp at hv; subst hv; simp [binDigits]
  | succ w ih =>
    have hbits : binDigits (w + 1) v = v.testBit 0 :: binDigits w (v / 2) := by
      simp only [binDigits, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
      congr 1
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro i _
      simp [Nat.testBit_add_one]
    rw [hbits, List.map_cons, Nat.ofDigits_cons, ih (v / 2) (by rw [pow_succ] at hv; omega)]
    rw [Nat.testBit_zero]
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one v with h | h <;> simp [h] <;> omega

/-- Fixed-width digit strings distinguish the values in their representable range. -/
private theorem record_digits_inj (w u v : ℕ) (hu : u < 2 ^ w) (hv : v < 2 ^ w)
    (h : binDigits w u = binDigits w v) : u = v := by
  rw [← record_digits_value w u hu, ← record_digits_value w v hv, h]

/-- **Canonical decoding** (design §12.8a §2). On windowed configurations of
one input, records agree exactly when the configurations agree on state, input
position, work tapes and work heads, and the tags agree. The output is not
compared, so this is injectivity on the configuration core, the vertex
quotient of the configuration graph.

**Proof sketch.** Compare the fields. The state field gives the state. The
position field is `Turing.binDigits` at a width with `2 ^ posWidth |x| >
|x| + 1`, which is injective on values `≤ |x| + 1`, the range of input
positions. For tape `i`, the content track gives the cells in `[-s, s]`, and
outside it both configurations are blank by the window hypothesis. The mark
track has exactly one mark, at the head, which lies in `[-s, s]`. The tag field
gives the tag. -/
theorem cfgRecord_inj {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) {c d : Cfg k Bool Q x}
    {τ τ' : T} (hc : c.InWindow s) (hd : d.InWindow s) :
    cfgRecord s c τ = cfgRecord s d τ' ↔
      (c.state = d.state ∧ c.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ c.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        c.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) ∧ τ = τ' := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [cfgRecord, List.cons.injEq, bind_pure_comp, Functor.map, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] at h
    obtain ⟨hstate, hpos, hrest⟩ := h
    have hs : c.state = d.state := by simpa using hstate
    have hb : binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val =
        binDigits (posWidth x.length) d.inputPos.val :=
      (List.map_inj_right (fun _ _ h => RecSym.digit.inj h)).mp hpos
    have hp : c.inputPos = d.inputPos := Fin.ext
      (record_digits_inj _ _ _
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (by have := c.inputPos.isLt; omega) (record_pos_lt x.length))
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (by have := d.inputPos.isLt; omega) (record_pos_lt x.length)) hb)
    obtain ⟨hfields, htag⟩ := List.append_inj' hrest (by rfl)
    have ht : τ = τ' := by simpa using htag
    have hcell (i : Fin k) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 * s + 1) :
        RecSym.cell (Q := Q) (T := T) (c.workTapes i ((j : ℤ) - s))
            (decide (c.workTapePos i = (j : ℤ) - s)) =
          RecSym.cell (d.workTapes i ((j : ℤ) - s))
            (decide (d.workTapePos i = (j : ℤ) - s)) := by
      have hi := List.map_inj_left.mp hfields i (by simp)
      exact List.map_inj_left.mp hi j (List.mem_range.mpr hj)
    have hw : c.workTapes = d.workTapes := by
      funext i z
      by_cases hz : |z| ≤ (s : ℤ)
      · have hz' := abs_le.mp hz
        have hnat : (((z + s).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = z + s := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
        have h := (RecSym.cell.inj (hcell i (z + s).toNat (by omega))).1
        simpa only [hnat, add_sub_cancel_right] using h
      · rw [hc.2 i z (by omega), hd.2 i z (by omega)]
    have hh : c.workTapePos = d.workTapePos := by
      funext i
      have hi := abs_le.mp (hc.1 i)
      have hnat : (((c.workTapePos i + s).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = c.workTapePos i + s :=
        Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have h := (RecSym.cell.inj (hcell i (c.workTapePos i + s).toNat (by omega))).2
      simp only [hnat, add_sub_cancel_right, decide_true] at h
      exact (of_decide_eq_true h.symm).symm
    exact ⟨⟨hs, hp, hw, hh⟩, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hs, hp, hw, hh⟩, ht⟩
    simp only [cfgRecord, hs, hp, hw, hh, ht]

/-- **Valid records** (design §12.8a §2): the field list is the record, at
radius `s`, of some windowed configuration on some input of length `n`, with
some tag. -/
def RecordValid (k n s : ℕ) (Q T : Type) (fs : List (List (RecSym Q T))) : Prop :=
  ∃ (x : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T), x.length = n ∧ c.InWindow s ∧
    cfgRecord s c τ = fs

/-- **Validity is a shape condition** (design §12.8a §2). A field list is a
valid record exactly when it has `k + 3` fields: a state cell; `posWidth n`
digits of a value at most `n + 1`; for each tape, `2s + 1` work cells of which
exactly one carries the head mark; and a tag cell. This shape supports a
validity machine built from finite-state folds over the fields, given the
widths `2s + 1` and `posWidth n` and the bound `n + 1` as templates or
counters. A fold of one field alone cannot check a variable width: a single
marked cell is valid at `s = 0` and not at `s = 1`. The validator itself is
deferred to S1b's statement phase.

**Proof sketch.** Forward: read the shape off `Turing.cfgRecord`, with the mark
at index `pos + s` of each tape field, which is in range by the window
hypothesis. Backward: take the input `List.replicate n false`, the state and
the tag from their cells, the input position from the digits, and for tape `i`
the cell at `z` from index `z + s` of its field when `|z| ≤ s`, and blank
otherwise, with the head at the mark minus `s`. This configuration is windowed
and its record is the given list. -/
theorem recordValid_iff {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} (n s : ℕ) (fs : List (List (RecSym Q T))) :
    RecordValid k n s Q T fs ↔
      fs.length = k + 3 ∧
      (∃ q : Option Q, fs[0]? = some [RecSym.st q]) ∧
      (∃ v ≤ n + 1, fs[1]? = some ((binDigits (posWidth n) v).map RecSym.digit)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, ∃ (cs : ℕ → Option Bool) (m : ℕ), m < 2 * s + 1 ∧
        fs[i.val + 2]? = some ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun j =>
          RecSym.cell (cs j) (decide (j = m)))) ∧
      (∃ τ : T, fs[k + 2]? = some [RecSym.tag τ]) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, c, τ, rfl, hc, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨cfgRecord_length s c τ, ⟨c.state, rfl⟩,
      ⟨c.inputPos.val, by have := c.inputPos.isLt; omega, rfl⟩, ?_, ⟨τ, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro i
      have hi := abs_le.mp (hc.1 i)
      have hnat : (((c.workTapePos i + s).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = c.workTapePos i + s :=
        Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      refine ⟨fun j => c.workTapes i ((j : ℤ) - s), (c.workTapePos i + s).toNat,
        by omega, ?_⟩
      simp only [cfgRecord, List.getElem?_cons_succ, bind_pure_comp, Functor.map, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simp), List.getElem?_map,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simp)]
      simp only [List.getElem_finRange, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro j _
      congr 1
      rw [decide_eq_decide]
      change (c.workTapePos i = (j : ℤ) - s) ↔ j = (c.workTapePos i + s).toNat
      omega
    · simp [cfgRecord, List.length_finRange]
  · rintro ⟨hlen, ⟨q, hq⟩, ⟨v, hv, hpos⟩, htapes, ⟨τ, htag⟩⟩
    choose cs m hm hfield using htapes
    let c : Cfg k Bool Q (List.replicate n false) :=
      ⟨q, ⟨v, by simpa using (show v < n + 2 by omega)⟩,
        (fun i z => if |z| ≤ (s : ℤ) then cs i (z + s).toNat else none),
        (fun i => (m i : ℤ) - s), []⟩
    have hc : c.InWindow s := by
      constructor
      · intro i
        change |(m i : ℤ) - s| ≤ (s : ℤ)
        have := hm i
        rw [abs_le]
        omega
      · intro i z hz
        change (if |z| ≤ (s : ℤ) then _ else _) = none
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    refine ⟨List.replicate n false, c, τ, List.length_replicate .., hc, ?_⟩
    apply List.ext_getElem?
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j < k + 3
    · rcases j with _ | (_ | j)
      · exact hq.symm
      · simpa [cfgRecord, c] using hpos.symm
      · by_cases hlast : j = k
        · subst j
          simpa [cfgRecord, c, List.getElem?_append] using htag.symm
        · have hjk : j < k := by omega
          let i : Fin k := ⟨j, hjk⟩
          rw [hfield i]
          simp only [cfgRecord, List.getElem?_cons_succ, bind_pure_comp, Functor.map, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
          rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hjk), List.getElem?_map,
            List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using hjk)]
          simp only [List.getElem_finRange, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          apply List.map_congr_left
          intro a ha
          have ha' := List.mem_range.mp ha
          have hz : |(a : ℤ) - s| ≤ (s : ℤ) := by rw [abs_le]; omega
          simp only [c, hz, if_pos, sub_add_cancel, Int.toNat_natCast]
          congr 1
          rw [decide_eq_decide]
          change ((m i : ℤ) - s = (a : ℤ) - s) ↔ a = m i
          omega
    · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by rw [cfgRecord_length]; omega),
        List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]

/-- **A record at a head** (design §12.8a §2): tape `r` holds the field layout
of `fs` from its head, delimited by blanks at relative positions `-1` and
`|joinFields fs|`. The cells beyond the delimiters are arbitrary. -/
def RecordAt {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type*} {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (r : Fin K)
    (fs : List (List Γ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ((joinFields fs).length : ℤ) →
    d.workTapes r (d.workTapePos r + p) = fieldsTape fs p

/-- **Reading a record** (the specification API, user 2026-10-16): `RecordAt d r fs` holds
exactly when, at every offset `p` with `-1 ≤ p ≤ |joinFields fs|`, the cell of tape `r` at its
head plus `p` holds `fieldsTape fs p`: the layout's cells, with blank delimiters at offsets `-1`
and `|joinFields fs|`. Cells outside that interval are unconstrained. -/
theorem recordAt_iff {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type*} {x : List Γ} (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (r : Fin K)
    (fs : List (List Γ)) :
    RecordAt d r fs ↔ ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ((joinFields fs).length : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes r (d.workTapePos r + p) = fieldsTape fs p :=
  Iff.rfl

/-! ### R8.7 — the record rows -/

/-- The shared segment specialized to the record verdicts and the common head box. -/
private abbrev RecordSeg {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (R : MultiTapeTM K Γ S)
    (yes no : S) (base : Fin K → ℤ) (radius : ℕ) (a b : Cfg K Γ S x) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Segment R {some yes, some no}
    (HeadBox (fun j => base j - radius) (fun j => base j + radius)) a b t

/-- The record's radius condition is the shared interval box, read through its API. -/
private theorem record_headBox_iff {K : ℕ} (base : Fin K → ℤ) (radius : ℕ)
    (p : Fin K → ℤ) :
    HeadBox (fun j => base j - radius) (fun j => base j + radius) p ↔
      ∀ j, |p j - base j| ≤ (radius : ℤ) := by
  rw [headBox_iff]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro j
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc, abs_le]
  omega

/-- Reading a record segment in the radius form required by the frozen public rows.
This is only the shared segment's characterization and the box/radius equivalence. -/
private theorem recordSeg_iff {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    {R : MultiTapeTM K Γ S} {yes no : S} {base : Fin K → ℤ} {radius : ℕ}
    {a b : Cfg K Γ S x} {t : ℕ} :
    RecordSeg R yes no base radius a b t ↔
      R.runFrom a t = b ∧
        (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom a u).state ≠ some yes ∧ (R.runFrom a u).state ≠ some no) ∧
        ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j, |(R.runFrom a u).workTapePos j - base j| ≤ (radius : ℤ) := by
  simp only [RecordSeg, segment_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    not_or, record_headBox_iff]

/-- A larger radius contains the old head box, for weakening with `Segment.mono`. -/
private theorem record_headBox_mono {K : ℕ} {base : Fin K → ℤ} {r r' : ℕ}
    (hr : r ≤ r') (p : Fin K → ℤ)
    (hp : HeadBox (fun j => base j - r) (fun j => base j + r) p) :
    HeadBox (fun j => base j - r') (fun j => base j + r') p := by
  rw [record_headBox_iff] at hp ⊢
  exact fun j => le_trans (hp j) (by exact_mod_cast hr)

/-- Read a one-exit row contract as its run equation, first-exit cut and per-tape head
envelope. The clauses are the shared segment reader's, with the exit set read as its single
member and the head box read tape by tape; nothing about the row is retraced. -/
private theorem recordStep_contract_clauses {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} {ι : Type}
    {R : MultiTapeTM K Γ S} {entry done : S} (C : Contract R entry {some done} ι x)
    (i : ι) (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (hd : d.state = some entry) (hp : C.pre i d) :
    R.runFrom d (C.time i d) = C.post i d ∧
      (∀ u < C.time i d, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some done) ∧
      ∀ (j : Fin K) (u : ℕ), u ≤ C.time i d →
        (R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (C.lo i d j) (C.hi i d j) := by
  obtain ⟨hrun, hcut, henv⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (C.segment i d hd hp)
  exact ⟨hrun, fun u hu hs => hcut u hu (by rw [hs]; exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl),
    fun j u hu => (headBox_iff _ _ _).mp (henv u hu) j⟩

/-- Read a row contract whose exits are a verdict family's range, as its run equation,
first-exit cut against every verdict, and per-tape head envelope, the same way as the
one-exit reader. -/
private theorem recordStep_contract_clauses_range {K : ℕ} {Γ S A : Type} {x : List Γ}
    {ι : Type} {R : MultiTapeTM K Γ S} {entry : S} {f : A → S}
    (C : Contract R entry (Set.range fun a => some (f a)) ι x)
    (i : ι) (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (hd : d.state = some entry) (hp : C.pre i d) :
    R.runFrom d (C.time i d) = C.post i d ∧
      (∀ u < C.time i d, ∀ a : A, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (f a)) ∧
      ∀ (j : Fin K) (u : ℕ), u ≤ C.time i d →
        (R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (C.lo i d j) (C.hi i d j) := by
  obtain ⟨hrun, hcut, henv⟩ := (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mp (C.segment i d hd hp)
  exact ⟨hrun, fun u hu a hs => hcut u hu ⟨a, hs.symm⟩,
    fun j u hu => (headBox_iff _ _ _).mp (henv u hu) j⟩

/-- The sweep rows' endpoint as the record literal the proofs below match on, assembled
from its published field equations. -/
private theorem recordStep_sweepPost_eq {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (done : S)
    (a : Fin K) (v : List Γ → Cfg K Γ S x → Fin K → ℤ → Option Γ) (w : List Γ)
    (d : Cfg K Γ S x) :
    sweepPost done a v w d = { d with
      state := some done
      workTapes := fun j q =>
        if j = a ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + (w.length : ℤ) then v w d j q
        else d.workTapes j q } := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [sweepPost_state]
  · rw [sweepPost_inputPos]
  · funext j q
    rw [sweepPost_workTapes]
  · funext j
    rw [sweepPost_workTapePos]
  · rw [sweepPost_output]

/-- The seek rows' endpoint as the record literal the proofs below match on, assembled
from its published field equations. -/
private theorem recordStep_seekPost_eq {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (done : S)
    (i : Fin K) (p : ℤ) (d : Cfg K Γ S x) :
    seekPost done i p d =
      { d with state := some done, workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i p } := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [seekPost_state]
  · rw [seekPost_inputPos]
  · funext j q
    rw [seekPost_workTapes]
  · funext j
    rw [seekPost_workTapePos]
  · rw [seekPost_output]

/-- Renaming the states of an explicit configuration record maps its state and keeps the
other four fields, as a rewrite rule for the endpoint conversions below. -/
private theorem recordStep_mapState_mk {K : ℕ} {Γ S S' : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (f : S → S') (st : Option S) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (wt : Fin K → ℤ → Option Γ) (wp : Fin K → ℤ) (o : List Γ) :
    (Cfg.mapState f ⟨st, ip, wt, wp, o⟩ : Cfg K Γ S' x) = ⟨st.map f, ip, wt, wp, o⟩ :=
  Cfg.mapState_eq_of_fields _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl

/-- A one-step run is one machine step, by the published run equations. -/
private theorem recordStep_runFrom_one {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (M : MultiTapeTM K Γ S) (d : Cfg K Γ S x) : M.runFrom d 1 = M.step d := by
  have h := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step' (tm := M) (cfg := d) (t := 0)
  rwa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at h

/-- One round of unit length is one machine step, by the published orbit equation. -/
private theorem recordStep_orbit_one_step {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (M : MultiTapeTM K Γ S) (c : Cfg K Γ S x) (r : ℕ) :
